Peter, the news coming out of Texas is horrifying.

A young mother with two children, Kate Cox, is pregnant with a fetus who has received a fatal diagnosis. Ms. Cox, with supporting documentation from her doctor, applied for an exception to Texas’ abortion ban to protect her own life and her future fertility.

A lower Texas court granted Ms. Cox’s request on Thursday, but the very next day, the Texas Supreme Court paused the order and eventually overturned the ruling – _leaving Cox no choice but to flee the state to have an abortion._

This is simply abhorrent. **No woman in our country should be forced to battle for their right to their own body publicly in the court system, nor should they be denied that right and forced to seek care elsewhere.**

**[It’s time to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law and make abortion safe and legal nationwide – full stop. If you are with me and if you agree that reproductive rights must be safeguarded, please sign our petition now:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75060852/443480198/-256378802?refcode=em-12.12.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDU2NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjc4YzlkOGUtNGE5OS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzY2JiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nKWFkRQqJYduJxgUPlNoeV2sPaLgLYYw9DrLt6MXzwU=&emci=8dbf9886-4a99-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=f78c9d8e-4a99-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=1771054)**

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=907%2E135344%2E1StUER)

Friend --
An open Senate seat in Michigan is a rare opportunity. With the retirement of the great Senator Debbie Stabenow, Republicans will be doing everything they can to win this swing seat and control of the Senate.
**I’m running for Senate because we need a new generation of leaders who think differently, work harder, and _never forget_ that we are public servants.** Being of service to the American people means bringing passionate, pragmatic leadership to Washington.
Service is something I’ve done my entire adult life -- first in the CIA, where I served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military, and later at the White House, State Department, and finally at the Pentagon, as an appointee of President Obama. Thanks to people like you, I’ve served two full terms in Congress, winning three extremely competitive elections in a Republican district.
**[A contribution of $3 or more today will help us show everyone we'll have what it takes to win this election. Please chip in today to help us raise the resources we need to win in this notorious swing state.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231212-2-tt&amount=3&t=2&akid=907%2E135344%2E1StUER)

But separate from my national security background, what motivated me to first run in 2018 was much more personal – my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 – and she didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience – of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork – fueled me to run when the GOP threatened protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Now Republicans want to put Social Security and Medicare on the same chopping block. Prescription drug costs continue to spiral out of control, and many have to choose between life-saving medicine and their rent or food. We are not settled, as a nation, on access to healthcare and this issue requires real change in Washington. **By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare.**

Peter Willis,

After being the only non-Republican Senator to vote against unconditional aid to support Bibi Netanyahu’s illegal bombing campaign in Gaza, Bernie Sanders is speaking truth to power once again by denouncing America’s outrageous decision to veto a UN resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire and the release of all hostages held by Hamas.

As Bernie said, with thousands dead and the medical system failing in Gaza, innocent children desperately need the food, water, and medical supplies that could be brought in with a humanitarian ceasefire.

Netanyahu’s extreme right-wing government is creating the conditions for more terror by bombing civilians, which plays directly into the hands of Hamas.

Add your name here to join Bernie in denouncing America’s horrific decision to veto the UN resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire and the release of all Hamas hostages. (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13077?source=EM_NBI_OR_20231212_PT_bernieveto_0_6MO_ourrevolution_na_na_bernievetopt&t=1013&akid=5032%2E5885482%2EbQjTd9)

Hamas’ attack on October 7th was unimaginably cruel and had no place in a civilized society. Israel has every right to defend itself against it and to take the steps necessary to secure the release of the civilian hostages they are still holding.

That’s why it’s so wrong that a resolution calling for the release of hostages, which is what this war is supposedly trying to achieve, was vetoed by the United States.

This veto only further empowers the extremists on both sides, endangers the lives of more innocent people, and creates the conditions for more terror.

Sign here if you agree with Bernie Sanders that the decision of the United States to veto a resolution calling for the release of hostages and a humanitarian pause in Gaza is dangerous and wrong. Hi Peter, This email is a bit longer than the ones I normally send, but I have a lot to say about this issue. I first ran for Congress because I saw a broken political system, one that ignored working families and instead served powerful interests. I wanted to be a voice for the voiceless, and a representative for women, young people, queer people, who don’t often get a seat at the table. And then, I was forced out by a coordinated cyber-attack from Republican operatives and right-wing media outlets — one of the worst cases of dirty gutter politics in recent memory. And my life since has been forever changed. Since leaving Congress, I’ve dealt with lots of anxiety, feared for my safety, but I never stopped believing that what happened to me was unfair. I stepped down from my position after being blackmailed with pictures published without my consent — but there are dozens of men credibly accused of sexual assault who sit in boardrooms and elected offices to this day. **It’s important for me to stand up and call out this double standard, so that women — especially young women and queer women — know that there is still a seat for them at the table. We cannot let my story scare them off from jumping into the fight, from daring to stand up and claim power. ** And I need you with me — because we’re more powerful together than we are on our own. **I need my former colleagues to get the message loud and clear: Revenge porn needs to be made a federal crime. It’s essential that we protect others from what I went through. And we now have a chance to get it done. ** [_**Please, Peter, take a moment to sign our petition to pass the _SHIELD Act_ before it’s too late.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75062768/443509827/1084763518?refcode=AU_HTP_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231212_PM2_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmI2NGM4MzMtNTM5OS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzY2JiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6Mr22ne1mAi1o8BFI1-c62kRn-SA90qJ7OewXW0QIGE=&emci=f2f6c82d-5399-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=bb64c833-5399-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=1720400) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75062779/443509850/1084763518?refcode=AU_HTP_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20231212_PM2_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmI2NGM4MzMtNTM5OS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MjIzY2JiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6Mr22ne1mAi1o8BFI1-c62kRn-SA90qJ7OewXW0QIGE=&emci=f2f6c82d-5399-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=bb64c833-5399-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=1720400)

I'm disappointed, friend — but I'm hardly surprised.

Congress is approaching another budget fight, and you know what that means: a whole lot of Republican "concerns" about the deficit as cover to justify which lifeline programs they want to cut.
So allow me to offer a radical idea: what if we finally made billionaires pay their fair share of taxes – reducing the deficit _and_ allowing the middle class to better share in the prosperity?
**Enter: my Billionaires Income Tax. A plan to finally ensure billionaires pay their fair share, just like the rest of us.**
A hard-working teacher or firefighter in Philomath, Oregon, doesn't get to call up an army of high-priced lawyers and accountants whenever they don't feel like paying their taxes. Working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, but the same rules don't apply to billionaires.
[**Will you stand with me in this fight by signing your name to my petition to tell Congress to make billionaires pay their fair share?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75064277/443522023/864091876?contactdata=eO7NYIYamsT9+rshLnAaCHuD4kRhqXf3OjHo62t2X8LuJPonFQI+D4rlV9f9W/kVhPZOHkCrBGVH9XENyLioQpw5I8HS7FT5NFk+JOiGr7o=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTFiN2Q5Yi02MTk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aHp5DzyNuUZnYah34_OtzeGphGQcekvCStVMxii87kI=&emci=d90b24a6-3899-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=d51b7d9b-6199-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=9818364)
[Sign Your Name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75064278/443522024/864091876?contactdata=eO7NYIYamsT9+rshLnAaCHuD4kRhqXf3OjHo62t2X8LuJPonFQI+D4rlV9f9W/kVhPZOHkCrBGVH9XENyLioQpw5I8HS7FT5NFk+JOiGr7o=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTFiN2Q5Yi02MTk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aHp5DzyNuUZnYah34_OtzeGphGQcekvCStVMxii87kI=&emci=d90b24a6-3899-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=d51b7d9b-6199-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=9818364)
Think about it — if billionaires and the biggest corporations **paid their fair share** , we could make our country a better place to live, work, and raise a family for everyone, not just those at the very top. We could make much-needed investments in critical lifelines that Americans rely on like Medicare and Social Security, among others.
But making my plan a reality won't be easy. The ultra-wealthy and their loyalists in Congress are sure to put up strong opposition. So I'm counting on voices like yours to help me take this to the finish line.
**You know as well as I do: the majority of Americans are sick and tired of paying what they owe while our country's wealthiest and well-connected keep cheating the system. We recognize both the urgent need and opportunity before us.**
[**So please sign on to tell Congress to ensure billionaires start paying their fair share and restore fairness to our system.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75064279/443522025/864091876?contactdata=eO7NYIYamsT9+rshLnAaCHuD4kRhqXf3OjHo62t2X8LuJPonFQI+D4rlV9f9W/kVhPZOHkCrBGVH9XENyLioQpw5I8HS7FT5NFk+JOiGr7o=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTFiN2Q5Yi02MTk5LWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgyMjNjYmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aHp5DzyNuUZnYah34_OtzeGphGQcekvCStVMxii87kI=&emci=d90b24a6-3899-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&emdi=d51b7d9b-6199-ee11-8925-002248223cbb&ceid=9818364)

clean_body: The majority of Americans are sick and tired of paying what they owe while our country's wealthiest and well-connected keep cheating the system. | | | We wanted to make sure you saw Ron's message from last week on his new push to make billionaires pay their fair share of taxes. Your voices will ensure that the issue of wealth inequality remains front and center — and that folks are talking about Ron's solution that will help all Americans. More soon, Team Ron Forwarded Message | Congress is approaching another budget fight, and you know what that means: a whole lot of Republican "concerns" about the deficit as cover to justify which lifeline programs they want to cut. So allow me to offer a radical idea: what if we finally made billionaires pay their fair share of taxes – reducing the deficit and allowing the middle class to better share in the prosperity? Enter: my Billionaires Income Tax. A plan to finally ensure billionaires pay their fair share, just like the rest of us. A hard-working teacher or firefighter in Philomath, Oregon, doesn't get to call up an army of high-priced lawyers and accountants whenever they don't feel like paying their taxes. Working families pay taxes out of each paycheck, but the same rules don't apply to billionaires. Think about it — if billionaires and the biggest corporations paid their fair share , we could make our country a better place to live, work, and raise a family for everyone, not just those at the very top. We could make much-needed investments in critical lifelines that Americans rely on like Medicare and Social Security, among others. But making my plan a reality won't be easy. The ultra-wealthy and their loyalists in Congress are sure to put up strong opposition. So I'm counting on voices like yours to help me take this to the finish line. You know as well as I do: the majority of Americans are sick and tired of paying what they owe while our country's wealthiest and well-connected keep cheating the system. Fellow American -

I’m still settling into my new office – both the physical space and the position I now hold in the federal government. I’m going to be honest with you, the last few weeks have been a blur – but productive and exciting as well.

Believe it or not, there wasn’t a manual left behind that I can reference in this new role. So, as you can imagine, we’ve been wasting no time settling in and figuring out how to best prioritize your interests and needs. The American people deserve nothing less than my best and that’s what I intend to give.

[**I’m reaching out today because I want to make sure that my team has the appropriate email, phone number, and mailing address on file for you.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=de29170e15a84f1799f7894a24eef56a&_e=uImikL7bmrGxWOOcZuC3YfgsTtChtfgA1hbyNUiMcCs_1r3eig7dtG5v-SDwr7PX9a3ONwQ9e3hdNQ5JSi_qN26tYHftABtb-jNSTf4dZ_iNYbAgah6-5SgpV_TvKlRy1mPHVjp6hXpyTfxNDtGeEpa3v4FEZfm66BEr8-d1wZyk5k6-8YFlp94iBbDlu8iHKgO8n1YjPxcZXk-yvLJidOiP2PZozAANCyDHsnI3Clm-w218OHeeh34gwYSVZPfJ1jr9_Js-UC8IXH-sORcBacwD_Bc4wzLU5b_P5Bp3axG4sq0LUkXxR8nG2v9o77yex__WKZ_-xCW_PT61WmVeOIGNKdUarDfQTgLJMjEI939SDqWg_9-f41F00LdkyICRMNRiuxz1Cn2R6bTVMBfK6N_Y3XdAqNifP6ZE8GeeeaA1Ow1QC80fgisUrJANkOe6)
[** UPDATE OUR RECORDS **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=de29170e15a84f1799f7894a24eef56a&_e=uImikL7bmrGxWOOcZuC3YfgsTtChtfgA1hbyNUiMcCs_1r3eig7dtG5v-SDwr7PX9a3ONwQ9e3hdNQ5JSi_qN26tYHftABtb-jNSTf4dZ_iNYbAgah6-5SgpV_TvKlRy1mPHVjp6hXpyTfxNDtGeEpa3v4FEZfm66BEr8-d1wZyk5k6-8YFlp94iBbDlu8iHKgO8n1YjPxcZXk-yvLJidOiP2PZozAANCyDHsnI3Clm-w218OHeeh34gwYSVZPfJ1jr9_Js-UC8IXH-sORcBacwD_Bc4wzLU5b_P5Bp3axEvezuQTWvCzfWJBmKrGGzkvGcJslPTQb25PRaWXuH_fDfsoI-opEdhg9Yqu4vF4rEefCKVnv8XUGEz9SwREmTkc4VIpGHbQa-c4UM57ry2SeZ_kN596FFVINDOfaJvm_avf-ob_UDxL8NEYuD-XBwX)
Before my colleagues elected me the 56th Speaker of the House, our mailing list was mainly comprised of folks from the great state of Louisiana. _But now as Speaker, every Republican in the country is a constituent of mine and I need to be able to know I can reach out as needed._

Holding on to the House majority in next November’s election is going to be a tall order – [**but with you on our team, I know our chances will increase exponentially.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=de29170e15a84f1799f7894a24eef56a&_e=uImikL7bmrGxWOOcZuC3YfgsTtChtfgA1hbyNUiMcCs_1r3eig7dtG5v-SDwr7PX9a3ONwQ9e3hdNQ5JSi_qN26tYHftABtb-jNSTf4dZ_iNYbAgah6-5SgpV_TvKlRy1mPHVjp6hXpyTfxNDtGeEpa3v4FEZfm66BEr8-d1wZyk5k6-8YFlp94iBbDlu8iHKgO8n1YjPxcZXk-yvLJidOiP2PZozAANCyDHsnI3Clm-w218OHeeh34gwYSVZPfJ1jr9_Js-UC8IXH-sORcBacwD_Bc4wzLU5b_P5Bp3axEU8w8ArtRMRNZ9c9pZaRkyem4QkX-h0Yv3u4Kjd5ujTGf6q3WtPm7hJ40JHT5YCQBOI9E3BqiU8I2Gb_cdS1iN9-D5U3uxGju-aM3CpiNMWEGVfcLID6Ngj2U2mFYU90nuKT1LOuOBeoLoxEJM-bsl)

As we build out our campaign operation from the ground up, _**I am going to need every patriot to step forward.**_ So please, [**let me hear from you today.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=de29170e15a84f1799f7894a24eef56a&_e=uImikL7bmrGxWOOcZuC3YfgsTtChtfgA1hbyNUiMcCs_1r3eig7dtG5v-SDwr7PX9a3ONwQ9e3hdNQ5JSi_qN26tYHftABtb-jNSTf4dZ_iNYbAgah6-5SgpV_TvKlRy1mPHVjp6hXpyTfxNDtGeEpa3v4FEZfm66BEr8-d1wZyk5k6-8YFlp94iBbDlu8iHKgO8n1YjPxcZXk-yvLJidOiP2PZozAANCyDHsnI3Clm-w218OHeeh34gwYSVZPfJ1jr9_Js-UC8IXH-sORcBacwD_Bc4wzLU5b_P5Bp3axHF_iWrd_zKEDB3GyEOwu8am4LovWFb_ZiPbFvwma4Od8Ql-DDiAmxdYUvVr3EtAVueUxS5IB6bhMxZXGbZGCbB20rDHZhjk6IYE4ao64YRQYqOfLN77Qo5TJt578VCPI9sL-TAc0ycU8dTy5WqSpU_)

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk47tcj0oc1d9ga4a8v1b8nt1eimg6ebgs6ftedg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5im1o37cjh2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zn991q9iphtg7ij1tnqe833ivqpurrcv2njffqso_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5im1o37cjh2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlh6vu671ucqdrbvkdl9qf9jb7knaqtq4edolc1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5im1o37cjh2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgjlbpbnpr9kjd7lubjbeev1u2r9vhovkvi83u9g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5hmaoj0s1h2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zanlffpoqon7ad0s48247iem2qdhm5qg9lb2d4gg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5hmaoj0s1h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1a4th7bpb9ekj3eiqd26ju38d3q2v7nat1ag9i8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5hmaoj0s1h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Shift WA
subject: Our Twitter “spat” with Bob Ferguson
body:
We here at Shift WA recently had the opportunity to dive into the fascinating legal world, as understood by our beloved Attorney General and gubernatorial hopeful, Bob Ferguson. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62576318:WnQeHYiNp:m:1:2610672541:B7628906E040B01A27F034C792832EA8:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends,

We here at Shift WA have occasionally had the opportunity to dive into the fascinating legal world that our esteemed Attorney General and gubernatorial hopeful, Bob Ferguson, operates in - often to the exclusion of other rational beings. And it's a scary dive.

This week, we built on that with a delightful exchange with the man himself on Twitter/X, after he used his taxpayer-funded account to pat himself on the back for lawsuits he's been proud of filing because they generated money. Of course, we couldn't let him off the hook for leaving out part of the story.

So, we reminded AG Ferguson of the colossal disaster that was his angry legal attack on Value Village. You'd think he'd appreciate our refreshing honesty, right? Well, not exactly.

Here's how the exchange went:

AG Ferguson, clearly not accustomed to being called out on his own record, responded with no recognition of that record. In his response, Ferguson tried to narrow his record of losses to just one area, and then reveals his theory that, by paying off the Value Village loss with money from other work by the office, he somehow escaped using taxpayer funds for his massive loss. He hopes everyone will ignore the fact that all the money flowing through the AG's office is, indeed, taxpayer money - his office does not exist without us, not the other way around.

At Shift WA, we're committed to keeping an eye on liberal elected officials who seem to forget they work for the people. Where mainstream media outlets act as mouthpieces of the Left, we try to be a voice of reason.

But we need your support to keep up the good fight. **[As we draw near the end of the year, please consider contributing $100, $50, $25 and help us hold these officials accountable.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62576319:WnQeHYiNp:m:1:2610672541:B7628906E040B01A27F034C792832EA8:r)**

[ **Your contribution will help us continue to shine a spotlight**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62576319:WnQeHYiNp:m:1:2610672541:B7628906E040B01A27F034C792832EA8:r) on politicians like AG Ferguson, who think they can play fast and loose with our money - and the truth - while claiming they're doing us a favor.

Thanks for standing with us,

The Shift WA Team

I wanted to tell you a bit more about why this race is so important to me. My father was born in Italy, and like so many, his family came in search of the American Dream. He found it in New York, and I’m so grateful he did. He taught my brother and sister and I to work hard and to work for our community. He inspired my public service as Mayor of Glen Cove, Nassau County Executive, and U.S. Representative. But increasingly, the American Dream is out of reach for so many. The cost of living is way too high, people don’t feel safe on the streets, and our leaders are too busy with arguments and petty politics to solve problems like climate change or our broken immigration system. And to make matters worse, George Santos represented NY-03 for 11 months, in which he did nothing other than distract and divide us until he was finally expelled. [**Now, there’s a special election in NY-03 on February 13, and I’m humbly asking for your support. This race is a toss-up, so grassroots support really matters. We need to bring sanity back to our government so we can rebuild the American Dream. Can I count on you to pitch in now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb1baacfb-fa2c-4cde-b07e-f5a70ca91a0b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

December 13, 2023 The Israel-Hamas war and the alarming eruption of antisemitism across the nation's college campuses is presenting Jim Himes with a steep challenge in deploying his usual go-to rhetorical dodges. Himes, a supreme practitioner of 'having-it-both-ways' on every issue requiring taking a clear stand, is failing the test on this watershed issue. As highlighted is last week's [Campaign Update](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001fWdQYtBct4oa8dA7rs34z5bvpN14WI5MC9Y9Z9Hma5cCsFFHHdG9gs9_x1YT5s3nsiNhW3gOQ02t2PnD_gkOqs_2OMGV6_urkeZUfw9oL8mP8cW_kXxEwlOSnllwyAlWO091ffoytMooFnoKaeZo-Q==&c=ljoLBXwAVa6lcIUKSaGO4g52BHV2e-e0sF4dOvuSmo-8wo-ZUz0K4g==&ch=Z2AOlALkrO4TiDFVh4l1IZvwu4bcPzJ5TDEQ6-jdA_gfV6QqG_qU9A==), Himes has VOTED AGAINST both aid to Israel and against freezing the release of funds to Iran, while only VERBALIZING empathy for the Israeli people. Then last week we all witnessed the scandalous spectacle of the presidents of Harvard, U-Penn, and MIT literally getting tongue-tied in the well of the House, when they couldn't emphatically denounce their own students' and professors' calls for 'genocide of Jews,' as a violation of school policy! The university presidents' answers were so profoundly evasive and inadequate that Representatives Elise Stefanik (R) and Jared Moskowitz (D) sent a letter to the Boards of the three universities calling for the respective presidents' firing. The U-Penn president has since resigned in disgrace. The letter was co-signed by 72 members of Congress - but not Jim Himes. Instead, 'Having-it-Both-Ways-Himes' tweeted "There is something very wrong in elite American higher education." Yep, Himes offers a peep of a head-nod in the correct direction, but puts his name to nothing specific - all while he crawls back to huddle with the radicals, driving the narrative of the Democrat Party...and hopes no one notices his duplicity. Pathetic postings such as that nebulous tweet is exactly how Himes schemes to prop-up a façade as a Moderate here in the District. Be assured, what Himes is really concerned with are the radicals in his base who control his votes. He's petrified to be any more specifically critical of these universities - after all, many of the more vocal of his base are products of those institutions, which are currently being engulfed with antisemitism. But the era of duplicitous 'representation' in CT-4 has got to end now. Himes' duplicity over the past 15 years has driven the country into our multiple current crises. So - I'm calling on Mr. Himes to take a stand with moral clarity, and sign-on to the Congressional Letter to the remaining university boards. Then, instead of offering quick-hit media soundbites in DC, come back to your District and do what you never do. Hold a press conference here, discuss and defend your VOTES, and take an unequivocal stand supporting Israel's right to exist, as well as the Jewish people worldwide. And condemn these universities in no uncertain terms for their coddling, enabling, and in many cases, promoting antisemitism on their campuses. If elected I will seek to join the House Committee on Education and work against the WOKE radicalism and antisemitism which has overrun academia. What should be under serious consideration is a House Resolution withdrawing university tax exemptions and grants, unless they quickly come into line with the foundational values and standards of the American system. The 2024 election will be a referendum on this man's failed 15-year rule.
Jim Himes is NO Moderate

## House Sets Vote on Impeachment Inquiry
House Republicans passed a resolution approving a vote to authorize a formal impeachment inquiry into President Joe Biden. A floor vote on the resolution [is expected today.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8GOiIY_uKC4jbuctstLYeMw6zAeA1OlLdfJfV2n_Tp6Ejn6zJdZsq03v_PBUNf6jTHTg-cFAilBejJ8FtYEAE1x6C8BOOd9YanIM8YJVyvC-hrtFrrQaLzdpaDBjMAcgogQStQWklrlTkNgz1Ho5yVyiv0kRmJN-p1P31XWnvCJb_qA_dTrIXnkHrfGtP_GIwMxp4wUc7vj8GYasEVn-0zj4YMRqOtc8YJKhvOMRVcu6D156D9JXZsNR-d6ir2I2MTsZZCveMb5Hu4bU_KmZrzzMh7menj4f3vJL8BAAD__5LuYoY) The floor vote is expected to be very close. With George Santos no longer in Congress, the GOP majority [is only three votes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFurDAQRb_GdCDP2OC3hYvX0G3alMg242UiYxPwLtm_jzZSujS3udI50nm_TlfHifPtza1kayyTC5UfNAG2oFpUk25mG4mQVEMWjERtht7oZrGD8kB4Ae0iugE84DyEoKP2XpKLoWGLEhUgKJB9D7q7XPp_QcPQSzBAJggtaeZa9u6jcK4LxfQsD9q7UNYm2aXW7RDqv8BR4HieZ-e-uByvV-D4YgscAX9np-3uEweX20epdLSeZ8otrxu5sKyUa8v58877s9ntvJ2cEh-DEVreVsfpR1r_bvAdAAD__yBQXNo), assuming all members are present and Democrats vote no. House Speaker Mike Johnson says he has the votes. If approved, the measure gives legal authority to the ongoing investigation into Biden's activities. An actual vote to impeach the president would require a separate process and wouldn't take place until next year.
## Study: How Americans Feel About Their Wealth
A new report on "Everyday Wealth in America" found inflation is the top concern for Americans overall, but for affluent Americans, the biggest worry is the [current political environment](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu5CAUAL8Gd1jwALNbUFzjbq-90sL4sfsuGCxg18nfR4mULv2MNJp_t-XmKVG-__U7uh7L4kOnFy4SuFQc1KKHzUVEQDWgk1aAtpOxeni4YKYrYBQoNrNaE70KOsCk4aLtqpQayIEAJUEqKYyRerxezSVoORkhrUQbmBa4US91_F8o9wfG9FFeWMdQ9iG5R-9HY-oPg5nBfJ7nGMv7-myUsbUvhsF8lESdQmMwU47JdyqZn6VWwsYr7p4y96GW1jjlUHbka_XhDXvjPyrv5eCh5IA1cx9jemLuHDdMu89DddtxUkrUJsu0uO-e0ndf_33XZwAAAP__oSNvvg). "Affluent" is defined as having assets over $500,000. The 2023 Edelman Financial Engine study ([See It Here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79ugzAQgPGnwRvId_4XBg9dsqVrR3Qx53CVMRGxgvr2FZ27f9JP39dtupEUqY9PWjm2vE2Umrx5AuzB9Ggmq-aYmZGN4ghBow3eBauW6B1fDNDdJcxjNveQZtLgL24kxpy9kogaDSAY0M6BHcbRXZIF7zQE4JA6q3mWtu3D9ya1LZzLz_bmfUjbqkpcWnu-OvPR4bXD63EcA89cVqpZKtUkVLg-pPLr7M-CqbSll9rTyrsk6k-_w6va4_w8pBR5-dBZ_VhJyh_S_n_-DQAA___welfo)) showed that only 14% of Americans feel wealthy, and two-thirds say they'd need $1 million to feel rich. The problem? Roughly one-third of all respondents see credit card debt as the biggest barrier to building wealth, and a quarter feel "emotionally burdened" by what they put on credit. And 25% say social media makes them feel worse about their finances.
## Congress Race Uses AI 'Volunteer'
A congressional candidate in Pennsylvania is testing a solution to the problem of finding tireless campaign volunteers: Democrat Shamaine Daniels is using "Ashley," the [world's first artificial intelligence political volunteer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSpCAQxvGnwQwLGpCZgOASs7n0QouBVvuqFQvZsebtt2bjjb_k9_3_PaZHJKZ9-Rs3DG0uU0yNXjhpkNpIMJPtcpgRAU2HQXsF1g_O224NAGZ45gz-NrisQRnMyljzVNFFZW-qowAKjAZttHJO2_5-d7dk9eCU9hp9ElZhplZq_7_Q3lac-V1eWPtUto7D2tpxCvNHwChgvK6rr_jVsJ6fXcDYMK174bK8BYwbYpPxXBnf8iqV8ylnqmeTkeRRLqyY5VGYGqXIMsXtiLTsMkVmrPIDlZ_PIGDsasjHRcx0Dl5YtWyR-MfUfk_0HQAA__8SyWd7). Unlike a typical robo-caller, none of Ashley's responses are canned or pre-recorded. Instead, like ChatGPT, she's capable of having thousands of different one-on-one conversations at the same time. Daniels is trying to unseat GOP Rep. Scott Perry. Her campaign says Ashley is programmed to be fact-based when asked questions about either candidate. Currently, there are [no rules against](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFuxCAQheHTQIfFDGC8BUUad5s2pUVgvJ4IG8tGa-X20UZKl-ZVT_qk_-M-3SMX3h7vcaXQ5jrF1PhJE6ACo9BMVuYwEyEZSQG8Rut7561cQgSiT_Sziy4n725z7g2RS7YfIA_OSg6o0QCCAe0c2O52c0Oy0DsNHsgnYTVlbvXovipvbaG5fNcnHV2qqyxhaW0_hXkTOAocr-vq9lq4caqvg8Bxo-sUOL4UgSPg32Raazpi46RSXPfIj01FVimWQofSGgzAoOUR8n5xKXz2Xlj9WCOXX7r9X-InAAD__84OXG4) using artificial intelligence this way.

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

My team and I are committed to championing conservative solutions that fortify our nation's foundations -- faith, liberty, community, and life. We're boldly standing up for pro-life principles and leading the charge for the significant improvement of our education system, with special emphasis on the teaching of true American history. Your invaluable perspective plays a critical role in shaping the future of our efforts.

I have prepared a brief survey that seeks to understand your views better. The survey focuses on the following key areas:
* Our effectiveness in promoting and preserving conservative values.
* The impact of our 'Little Patriots' educational program.
* Our pro-life advocacy efforts.

You can start the survey here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/cye-2023](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1aed729910424f939a4d934a148d0333&_e=tSTG2A7POs58dDKnQ1yMqsBxC6SAgb7zDS66lTkzXox1kK3LJzLxF_PrhTboPVvg3Y5pb3ZAxTSN1uxsteh094w4m4Zc_7i2IL6CgnKk7zyoqvr-G30y3EgISBn-dcXiS0ZlUaD-MlY58uClQl8rTRQFH3GB6gqslmSoPZ_i1on1ow8QtZDJBS3EsVr-ORmqO5ZmJ1wxdf0lfBFtmy5hiIPC1VBOlSvtb9hcQNN69ZViRUehZXC7aNGBgiE4iVgM7_L3P2svGzp9PWTSbRcPzON3HKYZGVExgM4-ehck49OqW64GcNP2UETbW_K4Ek5-7Ujpt4hrh7eHzPx_zGSJB6Xudcz9sLft2FHfuusLCUSfEL90XNc5U8kLXKz2r3jh).

Your response will not only provide critical feedback but will also help me shape our future initiatives. I invite you to share your thoughts with me today. Your voice matters, and together, we can continue on our quest to preserve and promote the conservative values that make our nation great!

I sincerely appreciate your time, input, and unwavering support!

Best Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

My team and I are committed to championing conservative solutions that fortify our nation's foundations -- faith, liberty, community, and life. We're boldly standing up for pro-life principles and leading the charge for the significant improvement of our education system, with special emphasis on the teaching of true American history. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=631273fb3988489abe8ba858260d19a9&_e=LQCoq3J9he2ir8BtCh6f3BS9SR7pqxSpA1yi9TV1mBAcmFCbX0zwMEq2LKq2qDknsruVJeLZkfqmrlFdtLb0av_QA5dx1C4GGj47Y_ZmolHTWle5JNkDZGD9tNjcjk7ykFwplTIQd18kAytdARQdro9YYUtK8pW0oJWHxESo2zKbHV9r-gUuiB8gQKxjFEQelyKrhLW9UoXjQ7INyR93yAz45nrPRkZoO-TJ9bOYpVXk3lO7h5foE7UJLCSD8_oxRburKjIjFli1R0Zs0QLUwzZ3ptn1ZOt5Kk_V2eA-95hlvCLN-eohMdjWUn3Ga3uy6KxxDWLFNgh5xBtehY6D2D8GoQvuPe_ALYNdM8CXqDNiRp1pAD48LeMic_Dnwuv1) Although our resolve is unwavering, and our mission is clear, I need your help to refine our strategies and improve our efforts. Your invaluable perspective plays a critical role in shaping the future of our efforts.

I have prepared a brief survey that seeks to understand your views better. The survey focuses on the following key areas:
* Our effectiveness in promoting and preserving conservative values.
* The impact of our 'Little Patriots' educational program.
* Our pro-life advocacy efforts.

You can start the survey here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/cye-2023](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=631273fb3988489abe8ba858260d19a9&_e=LQCoq3J9he2ir8BtCh6f3BS9SR7pqxSpA1yi9TV1mBAcmFCbX0zwMEq2LKq2qDknsruVJeLZkfqmrlFdtLb0av_QA5dx1C4GGj47Y_ZmolHTWle5JNkDZGD9tNjcjk7ykFwplTIQd18kAytdARQdro9YYUtK8pW0oJWHxESo2zKbHV9r-gUuiB8gQKxjFEQelyKrhLW9UoXjQ7INyR93yAz45nrPRkZoO-TJ9bOYpVVjcIgd8obEOQSFL6Bg_FVUUO78fqJE76ERrtGLQIrNdmvg24vC8uroDeamvWIAer931_S1LYo7mowWy6mxINGI1vbN_INehJl_5LhwaGBTMpHsl7eHpvsMWdPd34K0DCB8zXOMhXuPcrnduAYv7MuV).

Your response will not only provide critical feedback but will also help me shape our future initiatives. I invite you to share your thoughts with me today. Your voice matters, and together, we can continue on our quest to preserve and promote the conservative values that make our nation great!

I sincerely appreciate your time, input, and unwavering support!

Best Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. | | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2569c326706c4f84b5ed8d0e38303ed4&_e=wlaGfDDM7N_Ll3qinzvzRNHaIZHnKgdux3JkCqu5YfZgUFDE641dqMnx2Ovtq2W-H-fyNYU-bNHfl6MaXwcMbiUAvmXa7oT1_hTiWBGYSqeCev-zA7tO5TlNgKkpIPVgc_giK987ox_dvD-MQOaEUAvJXwlej1YfNxEkklzD46sZUmBwXpjfR7a7ddQXNphaBPS46y5GodQk6a9Oyh8uOCzMbK48MGtpj5M-lP2E4gxQCxji2_lyWxwd923hs1hMR9KKvxI2vVduGmlXIUsH4C3eQxI00Ru6bhukxWXlN94oX2plUdB2GZI8v60bSU2LXcG8Oj4s5Ld7ZD_iGkJ3Arxld77K9j9oC7jG7ydTwKVvUXVN967lUgbtnpuemWnD).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

Dr. Robert Jeffress

* Our effectiveness in promoting and preserving conservative values.
* The impact of our 'Little Patriots' educational program.
* Our pro-life advocacy efforts.

My legal team has filed our closing argument brief in the California State Bar trial seeking to have me disbarred as a lawyer. This has been a surreal, exhausting battle to defend my integrity and legal actions from an onslaught of false charges leveled by radical leftwing lawyers working with lawfare groups. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination.

body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4684a1ea14e4cb9b20617e0d166a07a&_e=Lh_z-pU3vyTnREojVm4XIl9dYf4NYMm-MvohhRoB-jUfrenSvMeK715mhxx3ezunIE-yHIpoeQpMagNCN7RSjGRKp09zbo8Q8Ukdcjmxl7tdsAgJXgALvN3AYSzAJRX1tntQWTtrwcfGhIC_vriOgofR2B92KQlDwKaH-DfhQWjF13oNtfR6slYEh2qpgt7z9cbtpkQU2iLwhQ0690tOL8iDLH0IWLeHL4Zqk1mH_gHui8j7vrk9wRfQSEAMdAaoswsaftriB03KvbvOiXYUDcuGYvGdTa_t_M8zvHL3JqikLFK231vvYwIh9LhmaYNsEgYFZT4r0qzBL2FjOtI_DE2fB4LNS5lWnjGMwaqQ_RB2dLZUhQA49ql4P5hDH0kvlYddef3bcZoI3CbbHilVNg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4684a1ea14e4cb9b20617e0d166a07a&_e=Lh_z-pU3vyTnREojVm4XIl9dYf4NYMm-MvohhRoB-jUfrenSvMeK715mhxx3ezunIE-yHIpoeQpMagNCN7RSjGRKp09zbo8Q8Ukdcjmxl7tdsAgJXgALvN3AYSzAJRX1tntQWTtrwcfGhIC_vriOgofR2B92KQlDwKaH-DfhQWjF13oNtfR6slYEh2qpgt7z9cbtpkQU2iLwhQ0690tOL8iDLH0IWLeHL4Zqk1mH_gGmRvkaSu7znDHsY7mmnAhoEZ4TDJJ0webnEf4YEMTC9o7OhR5dMsM-XEXAi2y0HKYQTm6_fiAK6MqbIDuVz3hohybNgwzVPldSz9z4hyU8tGkgaZ0yJFmfIo-gRSUvbykEin78mFY76HagsgLG8bTCsi7prq-RzAWQ6JgSlHSZkw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f4684a1ea14e4cb9b20617e0d166a07a&_e=Lh_z-pU3vyTnREojVm4XIl9dYf4NYMm-MvohhRoB-jUfrenSvMeK715mhxx3ezunIE-yHIpoeQpMagNCN7RSjGRKp09zbo8Q8Ukdcjmxl7tdsAgJXgALvN3AYSzAJRX1tntQWTtrwcfGhIC_vriOgofR2B92KQlDwKaH-DfhQWjF13oNtfR6slYEh2qpgt7z9cbtpkQU2iLwhQ0690tOL8iDLH0IWLeHL4Zqk1mH_gF8Hxls30M0wyrTnmAnBWoEYkOm4NovH-ryHz39k_Foh_CyC-8HoAR0BgRTKCJAIWHA4deJFzC3yR_lE5jCKvkxbgQHaKUYsJscG8n-wkzyJaDvQt8Ts2BIzLZ2OpetwigX-qNrwy45UZJGc4jYhNcRJrTAUTFrgFzw2Y5hstkuqw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Dear Fellow Patriot,

Insane leftist policies threaten to destroy our country. Leftist policies cause open borders, rampant corruption, rising crime, and the erasing of American freedom. And the corporate media refuses to cover these failures and instead push their own leftist narratives. Americans are fed up with the lack of action to fix these problems and save our crumbling republic.

But the fight isn’t lost.

The Heritage Foundation has developed four key initiatives to defeat the leftist agenda and tackle these critical issues head on.

**Through Project 2025 we’ve devised a plan to dismantle the deep state** by training thousands of patriotic Americans to staff the next presidential administration, enact conservative policy solutions, and replace the deep state’s leftist bureaucrats.

**We’re taking on government corruption through the Heritage Oversight Project**. Our expert team of lawyers and investigators are in the trenches, filing lawsuits and Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the D.C. swamp’s wrongdoings and hold perpetrators accountable.

**We’re working to end Biden’s open borders** by developing key public policy solutions that will secure America’s borders. Just this year, The Heritage Foundation’s research was pivotal to the House-passed Secure the Border Act.

And through our **Election Integrity Scorecard** , we’re holding state policymakers accountable by ranking the security and integrity of each state’s election laws and procedures. Governors and state policymakers contact our team frequently looking for ways to improve their score.

All of these projects will defeat leftist policies and bring about success for our country next year. But I need your support to get them over the finish line.

**Please give a tax-deductible gift today to help support this comprehensive plan to save America using the secure link below:

[https://secured.heritage.org/eoy-campaign/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37741%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=APtGtfd0E7l3UC6SZM7Ncg&sysid=1)**

Your generous support will ensure these initiatives achieve great wins for our country as we enter 2024.

Sincerely,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.
President, The Heritage Foundation

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsitc7YigN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/ositc7YigN

Fellow
Patriot,

America
is on the brink of destruction.

I don't
say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true.

What we
see today didn't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement
that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been
100 years in the making…

…and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast
tracking their agenda.

I'd know
better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the
leaders of the movement destroying America today.

50 years
ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we
know it to an end.

I stood
side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black
Panthers. I edited Ramparts - radical Left's largest magazine. I
marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and
however I could.

Then the
Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists
win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible
destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and
never looked back.

I cast my
1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz
Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40
years to exposing them.

Why?

Because I
knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what
was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what
I knew, we would lose our country forever.

That's
why I spent 6 months writing The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian
Movement Is Destroying America - and I want you to have your very
own copy of it.

So I'm
asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible
donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you,
I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.

When you
think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy
Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez…and you wouldn't
be wrong.

But make
no mistake: The real mastermind is Barack Obama.

Barack
Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020
back in 2008.

Barack
Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black
Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police
upholding the rule of law.

Barack
Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a
laughingstock on the world stage.

And
Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian
collusion witch hunt.

The
devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade
in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what
we're up against.

That's
why I wrote The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is
Destroying America to explain how communist and fascist Leftists
infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...

...how it
has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very
foundations of our country...

…
and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and
cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political
opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse.

The
reviews speak for themselves…

"A Great
Book" - Dinesh D'Souza

"The
Enemy Within is a book for all patriots who understand that our
country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin

"David
Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned
about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham

I wrote
The Enemy Within because...

I know if
our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly
how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is.

I was the
enemy within - and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat
them.

We've
reached the point in our history that will decide our future -
and we either win these political battles or lose everything that
makes us prosperous and free.

That's
why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when
you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us
the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every
American patriot.

The Left
is at war with America.

They
don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country
better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist
dystopia.

Or in
Obama's own words "radically transform" America.

And they
don't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve
it.

So it's
up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left
to our fellow Americans while we still can.

Sincerely,

David
Horowitz

P.S. I
know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we
get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a
thread. Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the
Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I'll rush a
complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.

The David
Horowitz Freedom Center is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.
All donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law.
Support
the Freedom Center through a contribution today.
© David
Horowitz Freedom Center | www.HorowitzFreedomCenter.org
P.O. Box
55089, Sherman Oaks, CA 91499

body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z68sbrj1iiqevcbuuulod3rap948jk783eim8cr0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie0ob2c9h2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj3aiumnnitolb5allllso22t8q0tn3o1m4hrjm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie0ob2c9h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z65jpfsslndlg9pkdsda6ft0i95g4uh560lqp418_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie0ob2c9h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0sckjuoj3o5a28oh2vd8vmjtnl8gf0tk7pevpbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie0ob2c9h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

1600 Daily

Peter,
Today we celebrate the National Guard's Birthday!

I am proud to take a moment to express my deepest gratitude to the brave men and women who serve in the National Guard, both here in Texas and across our great nation.

The National Guard has a history of selfless service, responding to the call of duty whenever and wherever needed. From natural disasters to overseas deployments, our National Guard members exemplify dedication, courage, and resilience. Their commitment to protecting our communities and preserving our freedoms is truly commendable.

As we reflect on the National Guard's remarkable contributions, it is important to recognize the sacrifices made by these citizen-soldiers and their families. Whether it's responding to emergencies at home or serving in challenging environments abroad, the National Guard plays a vital role in ensuring the safety and security of our nation.

I am committed to supporting policies and initiatives that enhance the capabilities and well-being of our National Guard. Their readiness and effectiveness are essential components of our national defense strategy, and I will continue working to ensure they have the resources and support they need.

On this special day, let us take a moment to express our gratitude to the members of the National Guard and thank them for their service and sacrifice. Their dedication to duty and their commitment to the principles that make our nation great deserve our utmost respect.

Thank you for joining me in honoring the National Guard on their Birthday.

Sincerely,

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. | | | Dear Friend,
---
My legal team has filed our closing argument brief in the California State Bar trial seeking to have me disbarred as a lawyer. This has been a surreal, exhausting battle to defend my integrity and legal actions from an onslaught of false charges leveled by radical leftwing lawyers working with lawfare groups. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination.

Dear Friend,
We wanted to make sure you saw Shamaine’s email message about our work with a new AI technology that will allow us to have real conversations with voters across PA-10. We are the first campaign ever to use this new technology, and we couldn't be more excited.
When we announced our rollout of this new AI tool yesterday, we made news across the country. In case you missed it, you can read about it in POLITICO [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] , Forbes [https://www.forbes.com/sites/rashishrivastava/2023/12/12/this-congressional-candidate-is-using-ai-to-have-conversations-with-thousands-of-voters/?sh=53e4ae5610f7] , and Reuters [https://www.reuters.com/technology/meet-ashley-worlds-first-ai-powered-political-campaign-caller-2023-12-12/] .
We know that Shamaine would prefer to call each voter and knock on every door in the district herself. With over 468,000 voters in PA-10, it’s just not physically possible. That is why using an AI assistant to reach these voters will be so important to this campaign. We’ll be able to make sure that voters know of the work Shamaine has done on the Harrisburg City Council for the past 10 years. We’ll be able to share her vision and the issues important to her. More importantly, we’ll be able to hear directly from voters about what matters to them and their families.
Running a campaign like this is going to require resources and we need your help. December 31st is the next big fundraising deadline. Can you chip in $250, $100, or even $50 to help us reach our aggressive end-of-year goal? Click here to contribute whatever you can. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for all you’re doing to support Shamaine,
Team Daniels

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

| | Peter, I’d love to share my plan for when I’m elected to the U.S. Senate, so this is a longer, policy-heavy email — so please, bear with me. There are a lot of issues that need to be addressed, and we need to elect more leaders willing to fight for the people they represent, Peter. Here are 3 issues that come up on the campaign trail that I’d love to give you my thoughts on: **Protecting Reproductive Freedom** Abortion is health care, full stop. I’m proud that Maryland values reproductive rights, but there are entire regions of the country where that’s not the case — _and the results of that are devastating for women, their families, and their communities._ That’s why I’ll never stop fighting on behalf of everyone’s freedom to make their own choices about how, when, and if they choose to start a family. Those decisions should be made by women and their doctors — not politicians. The state-by-state laws since _Roe_ fell can be confusing, terrifying, and difficult (if not impossible) to navigate for millions of women. We need to pass a federal law that protects abortion access nationwide. Anything less would be a disservice to women everywhere. I am so proud to have the support of groups like Reproductive Freedom for All (formerly NARAL) and EMILYs List, who know that Marylanders deserve a pro-choice champion representing them in the Senate. **Addressing the Climate Crisis** The very real effects of climate change are being felt more and more every single day, Peter. Coastal communities are at risk as waters continue to rise and storms and natural disasters increase in both frequency and intensity. Entire regions are suffering from droughts that put lives at risk and cripple the economy. The longer we put off facing reality and tackling the largest existential crisis humanity faces, the more difficult it will become to slow the effects of climate change. I am proud to have tackled these issues head-on as County Executive, where we’ve set ambitious targets to reduce emission levels and have acted to make important investments in stormwater management and making our transit systems more energy efficient. We owe it to our children and our grandchildren to do everything we can to ensure that they’re inheriting a stable, sustainable, habitable planet. **Lowering Costs for Families** Families are struggling, Peter. Whether it’s student debt, the skyrocketing costs of health care and prescription drugs, stagnant wages, or a lack of access to opportunity, **_we can and must do more._** Too many people are struggling to pay for childcare, or to keep their kids in school. They’re looking at stacks of bills and wondering how they’re ever going to get out from under it while they’re stuck paying off student loans and working multiple jobs. Parents should never have to face the possibility of not being able to afford medicine for their kids. Our seniors and our veterans shouldn’t have to be cutting pills in half to make ends meet. We need to empower workers, defend and strengthen union protections, raise the minimum wage, and reach out a helping hand to those around us. There’s still so much more we need to do, Peter, but we have to start somewhere. Thank you so much for taking the time to read all of this, Peter. When we win this race, I can’t wait to get to work for all Marylanders in the U.S. Senate. —Angela [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8603?t=9&amount=25&akid=745%2E52803%2ESnfTBd) | | | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/8603?t=10&amount=25&akid=745%2E52803%2ESnfTBd)

Dear Fellow Patriot,

Insane leftist policies threaten to destroy our country. Leftist policies cause open borders, rampant corruption, rising crime, and the erasing of American freedom. And the corporate media refuses to cover these failures and instead push their own leftist narratives. Americans are fed up with the lack of action to fix these problems and save our crumbling republic.

But the fight isn’t lost.

The Heritage Foundation has developed four key initiatives to defeat the leftist agenda and tackle these critical issues head on.

**Through Project 2025 we’ve devised a plan to dismantle the deep state** by training thousands of patriotic Americans to staff the next presidential administration, enact conservative policy solutions, and replace the deep state’s leftist bureaucrats.

**We’re taking on government corruption through the Heritage Oversight Project**. Our expert team of lawyers and investigators are in the trenches, filing lawsuits and Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the D.C. swamp’s wrongdoings and hold perpetrators accountable.

**We’re working to end Biden’s open borders** by developing key public policy solutions that will secure America’s borders. Just this year, The Heritage Foundation’s research was pivotal to the House-passed Secure the Border Act.

And through our **Election Integrity Scorecard** , we’re holding state policymakers accountable by ranking the security and integrity of each state’s election laws and procedures. Governors and state policymakers contact our team frequently looking for ways to improve their score.

All of these projects will defeat leftist policies and bring about success for our country next year. But I need your support to get them over the finish line.
