**Sheriff Joe Gamble Endorses John Teichert for Senate**
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**BALTIMORE, Md**. – With endorsements pouring in from state senators, delegates, and more, retired Brigadier General John Teichert is now adding law enforcement leaders to the list with Talbot County Sheriff Joe Gamble’s support.
Gamble has served in his capacity as Sheriff of Talbot County since 2014 and he’s also selflessly served in law enforcement for more than 30 years.
**“In the face of exponentially increasing crime rates in Maryland, we need a leader who is accountable and understands the critical importance of law and order,”** Gamble said in his endorsement. **“General John Teichert's distinguished military service and proven track record in leading with integrity make him the right choice for the U.S. Senate. As Sheriff of Talbot County and retired Maryland State Trooper and Commander, I wholeheartedly endorse General Teichert, confident that his commitment to public safety will be unwavering. Let's support a strong leader who prioritizes the security of our communities and works tirelessly to address the challenges those of us in law enforcement face. General Teichert is the advocate we need for a safer, more secure Maryland.”**
In response to the endorsement from Sheriff Gamble, General Teichert said the following: **“I’m honored to have the support of Sheriff Joe Gamble as I seek to bring leadership, not politics to Washington as Maryland’s next U.S. Senator. Crime has been a serious issue in Maryland and our political leaders are failing our communities. We need to support law enforcement to do their jobs, ensure our communities are safe, and work to dissuade our youth from a life of crime.”**
This endorsement is yet another benchmark in the strength Teichert is amassing in his bid for the U.S. Senate. As he continues to travel around the state talking with voters about the issues most important to their families and communities, Teichert’s endorsements and policy positions remind Marylanders why he should be their new leader in the Senate.

subject: I almost died defending the Capitol

body:
| I testified about that day in front of Adam Schiff and the House Select Committee on the January 6 Attack.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4730%2E5257348%2EK1PTQa)
Derek —
My name is Aquilino Gonell. I am a former U.S. Capitol Police Sergeant — and I almost died at the hands of insurrectionists on January 6, 2021.
My whole life, I worked hard to achieve the American Dream. I came to the United States when I was 12 years old, joined the U.S. Army, and later became a police officer — all in the name of defending this country and our Constitution.
But on January 6, 2021, at the hands of rioters incited by people like Donald Trump, Matt Gaetz, and Jim Jordan, I was violently attacked. Sprayed with bear mace. Beaten and bruised. Called a traitor.
Derek, I thought I was going to die on that day.
But I kept fighting — to defend our country and our democracy because my sense of duty was so strong.
I sustained severe mental, physical, and moral injuries. I needed two separate surgeries after defending our country from insurrectionists.
I testified about that day in front of Adam Schiff and the House Select Committee on the January 6 Attack.
I spoke about the attacks and insults I faced — because that day should never be forgotten and those who attacked the U.S. Capitol deserve to be brought to justice.
**And Adam Schiff fought relentlessly to reveal the truth about the January 6th insurrection and to make sure that those who incited violence against our country are held to account.**
That’s why I am proud to support Adam’s campaign for the United States Senate — because in the face of attacks and name-calling, he has stood with us. He doesn’t back down from the fight. He will do what it takes to defend our country, our Constitution, and our democracy.
**We need Adam in the Senate — because if there is a repeat of the January 6 attacks, will Republican elected officials help the officers secure the Capitol, or will they prevent officers from securing the doors from those trying to cause harm?**
Adam and I have kept our oath, defended the Constitution, and stood up for everyone in the building during and after the insurrection. Meanwhile, Trump called the rioters patriots. I know what side I’m on — do you?

Now, we have a special election on February 13, 2024. That is only 62 days from now!!

subject: Stop warrantless surveillance in the NDAA!

body:
| | [](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=xEaE4enJXWeAU2VA9SFyiroA8niGdH2TT0q5xTGZSRU&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ndaa_fisa_702&n=1)
---
| Friend, Congress is at it again—waiting until just before Christmas to push “must pass” legislation and then tacking on unrelated provisions and hoping no one notices or cares enough to object. But we did, and we do. One of the provisions tucked into the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), which is an atrocious bill in its own right, is **a four-month extension of Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA 702)** —the notorious section of law that ostensibly authorizes electronic surveillance of foreigners abroad but in practice **results in the vast collection and warrantless searches of Americans’ communications and other data.** The House this week was expected to consider two competing long-term proposals related to FISA 702—one good and one terrible—using an unusual voting scheme that would have all but guaranteed the establishment’s proposal came out on top. We’ll have more to say about these bills down the road, but for now the plan has been scuttled, and consideration of any longer-term reauthorization bill has likely been put off until sometime next year. **But the fight isn’t over.** FISA 702 is set to expire on December 31 of this year. **FISA 702 is blatantly unconstitutional, and unless Congress enacts real reforms to rein in warrantless spying on Americans, this outrageous law must be allowed to expire.** There is no amount of time for which it would be acceptable to extend a program that violates constitutionally protected rights in such an obvious and well-documented manner. Note also that this surveillance program operates under a one-year FISA court certification that’s valid until April 2024, _even if the underlying statute expires_. **These one-year certifications make the four-month extension of FISA 702 authority even worse: Extending FISA 702 until April would give the government time to obtain _another_ annual certification, meaning that in practice the NDAA would be approving this unconstitutional spying program until April 2025!** To reauthorize a mass spying program, without any reforms, by throwing it into a “must pass” bill at the end of the year would be a complete abdication of Congress’s responsibility to the American people. The people deserve better. **The Senate is expected to vote on passage of the NDAA (with FISA 702 extension) as early as TODAY. The House could then consider it as early as THURSDAY.** **But we can stop it.** Some members of Congress have already expressed serious concerns about including FISA 702 in the NDAA. **That’s why it’s critical to keep the pressure on by contacting your senators and representative and urging them to vote NO on the NDAA (H.R. 2670) if it comes to the floor with an extension of FISA 702.** **You can contact your members of Congress now by calling (202) 224-3121.** **Tell them “ Don’t renew FISA 702. Vote nay on the NDAA.”** In liberty, Justin Amash[](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/?e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ndaa_fisa_702&n=2)[](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/?e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ndaa_fisa_702&n=3) P.S. [Expand Liberty PAC](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=0J5d6UsHYTui5I2PvzUDdbQRDmSK_EA_LK2bvkKooqfovu2en6tjs0bXhetoOXwz&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ndaa_fisa_702&n=4) supports policies and candidates dedicated to the ideals of a decentralized future. [Sign up here](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=0J5d6UsHYTui5I2PvzUDdbQRDmSK_EA_LK2bvkKooqeU10AIuXmNXZP2ntMfEIJX&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ndaa_fisa_702&n=5) to join the team and take action.

name: Riley Gaines
subject: Join Me in Standing Up for Women’s Sports and American Values
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbdam7h20j7253pblffcp3qqqd6au4ul073mcgv8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie2o34c1h2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh4rmltgvlamkqd2iou43bgq3g6gispje5fpu5ig_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie2o34c1h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zppkkq5ihlsk20g98j3gkqdl6c3iltuqv8tc7vg0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie2o34c1h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2k5pia2r1m1cfq2tol73gffnqeoleiuurq7vdm0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32c5ie2o34c1h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

American Action News

Peter -
My name is Aquilino Gonell, former U.S. Capitol Police Sergeant, and on January 6, 2021 I almost died defending the Capitol from insurrectionists inspired by far-right leaders like Sheriff Mark Lamb.
In April, Mark Lamb declared his candidacy for the U.S. Senate in Arizona against my friend Ruben Gallego.
I am writing because inciting, cheering, and making excuses for an attack on our democracy should not be a prerequisite or credential to be in Congress or any position of trusted authority.
But that is part of Mark Lamb’s claim to fame. It’s why he can credibly run for U.S. Senate against Ruben.
So I am personally writing to ask for your help. To help elect Ruben. To help send a message that we cannot allow insurrectionist-cheerleaders to get into the United States Senate.
So please:
[**Can you make today the day you make your first contribution to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate in Arizona?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-dec23.csjDeB&refcode=em231213-1-f&t=2&akid=1550%2E734936%2EVyyW2G)
[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-dec23.csjDeB&refcode=em231213-1-f&t=3&akid=1550%2E734936%2EVyyW2G)
Mark Lamb says the insurrections were “very loving, Christian people.”
I can assure you they were not spreading the word of God as they cursed at law enforcement officers and assaulted us with multiple weapons. I wonder how Christian and loving the invading rioters were as they threatened to shoot me, and said that I, an Army veteran and police officer, should be executed.
I wonder how Christian and loving they were as the attackers pulled me in every direction by my leg and my shield.
But Mark Lamb doesn’t even have the courage to stand up for law enforcement officers injured or killed on duty that day. When asked about us, he said he wasn’t there and couldn’t say what was true or not.
I am going to do everything I can to help elect my friend Ruben Gallego — who also showed extraordinary courage that day. So I am humbly asking:

Use this link to give whatever you can afford to make sure he defeats Mark Lamb and anyone who runs against him in this race.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-dec23.csjDeB&refcode=em231213-1-f&t=4&akid=1550%2E734936%2EVyyW2G)

subject: Will you stand up to powerful polluters?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
Help us end utility companies' anti-climate influence
| | | | | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/339?t=2&akid=13910%2E53494%2E117Iby)
---
| | Hi, I have some uncomfortable news: You might be funding anti-climate lobbying.

Across the U.S., **bad-actor utility companies are using their customers' money to lobby against smart climate policy.**

Thanks in part to growing public pressure from folks like you, **some utility companies are shifting course and transitioning to clean energy. At the same time, several others are doubling down on the status quo** —clinging to polluting, expensive, and unreliable power sources like coal- and gas-fired power plants.

Earlier this year, we led a successful campaign to hold a major utility trade group accountable for dirty lobbying, but the fight isn't over as long as utilities can legally continue to fund anti-climate lobbying efforts with ratepayer dollars.

That’s why we're gearing up for our next push. **[**Are you in, Friend?**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5086?t=3&akid=13910%2E53494%2E117Iby)**
---
[**FUND OUR FIGHT AGAINST DIRTY UTILITIES**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5086?t=5&akid=13910%2E53494%2E117Iby)
---
**Here's our plan:** We've seen states like Colorado, Connecticut, and Maine pass bills that block utilities from charging ratepayers for their dirty lobbying.

**So we're preparing to use our policy influence and advocacy power to work in key states to pass similar legislation. **

[Your support today can fund grassroots advocacy and ad campaigns targeting state-level lawmakers, pushing them to pass these necessary reforms.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5086?t=6&akid=13910%2E53494%2E117Iby)
---
[DONATE NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5086?t=8&akid=13910%2E53494%2E117Iby)
---
A thriving, just, and inclusive clean energy future is coming, whether powerful polluters like it or not—the only question is how long they're going to be allowed to stand in the way.

**It's time power companies served the public, not fossil fuel interests.** With your help, I know we can make this a reality. Sincerely,

Justin Balik
State Program DirectorEvergreen Action

_**4 ways to repeal Obamacare**_ By Bobby Jindal
---
_Republicans should pursue incremental changes to Obamacare that empower patients not bureaucrats_ After previous elections highlighted the fight to repeal and replace Obamacare. Republicans are eager to move on from healthcare to more favorable political terrain like fiscal management and national security.

Obamacare has grown more popular and Republican voters are less excited about repealing the law. Donald Trump’s renewed commitment to repeal Obamacare worries Republicans eager to make the 2024 election a referendum on President Joe Biden’s handling of inflation, border security and international conflicts.

However, former president Barack Obama’s strategy of transferring healthcare costs from patients to taxpayers provides conservatives an opportunity to focus on increasing affordability by actually reducing costs. Democratic healthcare policies have left millions at risk of losing their coverage, and even Massachusetts Democrat Sen. Elizabeth Warren noting the industry consolidation and rising costs that resulted from Obama’s signature law. **[FINISH READING ON FOXNEWS.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=d326a90cbafe4e25a74bf61a699b1e85&_e=KsvL7VECASEP7_QQ-5u6oNs-6Na7Y4fbNrjz3F_x-kskcSso8fAVTeW1sYySBTFWuw9ybauXOAzo3tg5JBmeGIYOx0p4J3voJ6aN8VmcBzwIjOMrNTVP4DCDBO4xmNxZGEI2GxrijHH90Pz4rS15j8T8S57wOK_lnumDhHESkDf_qLmCNnrGOU6wS5ZnsgwKtKnCi-oEtDVqb28OUc-Is42ePkbr5o3D1iphbzKn021lvl8ffrK6x7de40ucOcFE)**

---

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

body:

Friend,

To paraphrase the rapper Nelly, it's getting hot.

Ambassador Nikki Haley just called me.

She is sending Congressman Ralph Norman to personally represent her at our Republican holiday reception Dec. 17 on St. Thomas.

In Congress, Norman serves on three important committees: Oversight and Reform; Budget; and Science, Space, and Technology.

You'll recall that Florida Governor Ron DeSantis is sending his surgeon general, Joseph Ladapo, to represent him.

Norman and Ladapo join Congressman Byron Donalds, who is being sent by former President Donald J. Trump.

Can I get you to join me at the reception?

Thanks to Host Committee members April Newland, Michael Meluskey, Dr. David Weisher and John Yob, the reception is now FREE for all attendees. We'll have an open bar and food.

Just reply to this email so I can put you on the guest list.

As I told a reporter, the Virgin Islands has never received this kind of attention from either major political party.

It says a lot of the work we've done in a very short period to rebuild the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands.

It also says a lot about how serious the 2024 Republican presidential candidates are treating our caucus on February 8. The Virgin Islands will be the third-overall Republican primary or caucus in 2024. Needless to say, that's HUGE.

Onward,
Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

subject: I Toured the Border. Here's What I Saw. 🤯
body:
The border crisis is far worse than I imagined.

Peter, I went down to the southern border last week in San Diego with my team to learn firsthand about the border crisis on the front lines.

We met with Border Patrol. We toured the wall. We watched as over a dozen migrants illegally entered the U.S. in a matter of minutes.

The conclusion: this border crisis is far worse than I imagined. Any candidate who isn't talking about this issue simply isn't serious.

We put together a video documenting what we saw and what we learned. I want to share it with you because the situation is far more serious than the media makes it seem. (https://www.maxforoc.com/secure-the-border-now?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Border_Video_Watch_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=7bf3101ce3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

I hope you have a few minutes to watch it. (https://www.maxforoc.com/secure-the-border-now?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Border_Video_Watch_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=7bf3101ce3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.maxforoc.com/secure-the-border-now?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Border_Video_Watch_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=7bf3101ce3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Our visit to the border was eye-opening. We toured a 50-yard gap in the border wall where anyone can easily walk through.

In fact, we watched over a dozen people do it in just the few minutes we were there.

We need to finish the wall and invest in border security. But the hard reality is that the border crisis is being caused by smugglers and cartels taking advantage of our country’s broken asylum laws.

This crisis won’t end until we overhaul those laws.

Congress needs to act immediately to tighten our asylum laws in three ways:
* Prohibit migrants claiming asylum unless they do so through a port of entry.
* Tighten screening to ensure illegitimate claims don’t get through.
* Improve the courts to decrease asylum claimants wait times to days, not years

Until we change our laws, the border will always be overwhelmed with people trying to get in.

These are the kind of common-sense, America First policies I plan to vocally fight for in Congress. Our leaders have gotten us into this mess.

If they aren't willing to change the laws, then it's time to change our leaders.

If you agree with me, please chip in whatever you can contribute TODAY to help us win this election. Our problems are solvable if we elect leaders with the resolve to solve them. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=Border_Video_Donate_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=7bf3101ce3-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Talk soon,

Max Ukropina

| | During this holiday season, many of us will be traveling through airports to visit friends, family, and loved ones. Last summer, the TSA announced a new facial recognition screening system for airports. Earlier this year, I introduced a new bill to stop it called **The Traveler Privacy Protection Act**. Here's why: The TSA program, which uses facial recognition to match passengers' faces with their government ID on file, is a slippery slope into a surveillance state. Nothing could be more damaging to our national values of privacy and freedom. TSA is now using facial recognition technology during the security screening process in airports around the country, and though they say it's optional, I've personally experienced agents making it difficult to opt out. **The bipartisan Traveler Privacy Protection Act aims to guard your privacy and prevent the TSA from using airports as a site to collect Americans' sensitive facial biometric data by:**
* Repealing existing authorization for TSA to explore facial recognition technology and require explicit congressional authorization for future use.
* Immediately banning the Transportation Security Administration from expanding its use of facial recognition.
* Requiring TSA to end its facial recognition program and dispose of facial biometrics data within 3 months.

We've seen the damage facial recognition technology does to privacy and to freedom in other countries around the world. **Let's not let it happen here.** Let's say no to the TSA using facial recognition in our airports. Team -
Throughout all of Elissa Slotkin's political campaigns, there has always been Rule #1. So today we'd like to take a moment to explain what that means in real terms for this team, and then ask you to chip in to help Elissa defend Michigan's Senate seat.
Here it goes: Back when Elissa first decided to run for public office, she had never been to a political fundraiser. Not one.
It might be hard to believe, but as a former national security expert, she had never attended a political event. It wasn’t her thing. Elissa therefore instinctively understood that one of the reasons so many Americans have lost trust in their government is because of the role that money plays in the political process.
**So that's what Rule #1 is all about: Elissa does not accept any money from corporate Political Action Committees.** She doesn't want her constituents to ever question why she is voting a certain way, or have any doubt that she is fighting for their interests.
Lots of people in Washington see this as a disadvantage. When she made the decision in 2018, and then stuck with it when she won, she got a ton of angry and annoyed phone calls. It meant she would have to work hard to raise the money and that big corporations couldn’t engage her easily, by paying for access. The same issues are coming up again given the amount of resources it takes to win a statewide Senate campaign.
**But for Elissa, Rule #1 is about protecting our democracy.** When you take a donation from a for-profit corporation, it makes average citizens question how that money impacts your vote.

clean_body: Team - Throughout all of Elissa Slotkin's political campaigns, there has always been Rule #1. So today we'd like to take a moment to explain what that means in real terms for this team, and then ask you to chip in to help Elissa defend Michigan's Senate seat. Here it goes: Back when Elissa first decided to run for public office, she had never been to a political fundraiser. Not one. It might be hard to believe, but as a former national security expert, she had never attended a political event. It wasn’t her thing. Elissa therefore instinctively understood that one of the reasons so many Americans have lost trust in their government is because of the role that money plays in the political process. So that's what Rule #1 is all about: Elissa does not accept any money from corporate Political Action Committees. She doesn't want her constituents to ever question why she is voting a certain way, or have any doubt that she is fighting for their interests. Lots of people in Washington see this as a disadvantage. When she made the decision in 2018, and then stuck with it when she won, she got a ton of angry and annoyed phone calls. It meant she would have to work hard to raise the money and that big corporations couldn’t engage her easily, by paying for access. The same issues are coming up again given the amount of resources it takes to win a statewide Senate campaign. But for Elissa, Rule #1 is about protecting our democracy. When you take a donation from a for-profit corporation, it makes average citizens question how that money impacts your vote. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination. | | The Federalist online news outlet recently published an article noting that I will need to raise $3-3.5 million to contend with the lawfare assault being waged against me. Though I have been blessed with over half a million in donations to my legal defense fund, I have already incurred legal costs of three times that amount. That is the very purpose of lawfare. body:
For 13 years, I walked the beat as a California cop. I've faced cartels, domestic terrorists, gang members, white supremacists, child predators... you name it. Then, as a medically retired officer, I faced another threat: politicians who want to defund the police and coddle criminals. | ****
---
Fellow American,

For 13 years, I walked the beat as a California cop. I've faced cartels, domestic terrorists, gang members, white supremacists, child predators... you name it. Then, as a medically retired officer, I faced another threat: politicians who want to defund the police and coddle criminals.

[**My name is Nick Wilson,**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bf379b1023454cb1ab46380e88aa234f&_e=fIUtqdDGiNYWefL2UmHpXq1IU0l8FEbnunieHO8Z6CtZJaOfZr7fqGjN5pfwd_5oreOHR5ouNdRqdQT-rifqJqdInggR8AHkJ3mUPao1ryEZRCuBu2uz0b2SWkEIls-KX-iQa439YPkfRBgeZ9t5GtPRus6_XJ-1RXEUgAXBkv5U0Vpt1QWos87S7tox5xqMN7xnrFbC5vIeFNa0c1hv1ebsuHxDkJAAR3G2Q3Qfjce2c0RbuQDI6CPtR5Oryrr4MEWuqDBxwgWW-Us6rsVJq3GTj1sqspnZ4ORmP1scVz9Cg6DyoyjjNGzY9SHCqaNrIuc7xE1tiUe1syfX4bweGw%3D%3D) and I'm running for the State Assembly to fight for you. I'm a father, a former cop, and someone who's seen the worst of what happens when politicians are out of touch.

I never wanted to be a politician. But when Gavin Newsom and his gang decided the government should raise my son, let criminals walk free, and attack cops, I knew I couldn't stay silent.

[**STAND WITH NICK WILSON
FIGHT FOR LAW & ORDER**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bf379b1023454cb1ab46380e88aa234f&_e=fIUtqdDGiNYWefL2UmHpXq1IU0l8FEbnunieHO8Z6CtZJaOfZr7fqGjN5pfwd_5oreOHR5ouNdRqdQT-rifqJqdInggR8AHkJ3mUPao1ryEZRCuBu2uz0b2SWkEIls-KX-iQa439YPkfRBgeZ9t5GtPRus6_XJ-1RXEUgAXBkv6fonsFAgY5Ld9u8kpfActMHIRSwJV4IeL1dnwa9coV7Gailfaw6ScQmDkEfpIagk5MkkJ5twoJ7EZ4HHo0E-aQUB0RMwivszSSxKgCjhrJMTzGckbmjgqj46m6XAybeKxAaEiwTUT_03vSucK5iSVKFC6MW3wibhpTHUqCziMhsg%3D%3D)
It's now or never. We can't hope for a better future; we have to fight for it. We need to restore Law & Order and make our communities safe again.

Join me. [**Let's take back power and put everyday Americans back in charge.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bf379b1023454cb1ab46380e88aa234f&_e=fIUtqdDGiNYWefL2UmHpXq1IU0l8FEbnunieHO8Z6CtZJaOfZr7fqGjN5pfwd_5oreOHR5ouNdRqdQT-rifqJqdInggR8AHkJ3mUPao1ryEZRCuBu2uz0b2SWkEIls-KX-iQa439YPkfRBgeZ9t5GtPRus6_XJ-1RXEUgAXBkv6Z4F4VHmeCjw4ZTj3YWl4C_TUee41pniijIi-RQ2ZFBH9Gq7r2xGUpIsXhKLtUQ4eglScr3eUGtAtE_C_noCRiFQDrQO7r7iFr0QV-UPHduiGD6GFrSBftYLtkEvEzmGqmtHdkWGc6Wn0fvdRxzUXUyVjSagApI_o7QWas7FVZ2w%3D%3D) With your support, we can make California a state where families are safe, criminals are held accountable, and our children can thrive.

Let's do this, together.

Respectfully,
**Nick Wilson**

[**STAND WITH NICK WILSON**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bf379b1023454cb1ab46380e88aa234f&_e=fIUtqdDGiNYWefL2UmHpXq1IU0l8FEbnunieHO8Z6CtZJaOfZr7fqGjN5pfwd_5oreOHR5ouNdRqdQT-rifqJqdInggR8AHkJ3mUPao1ryEZRCuBu2uz0b2SWkEIls-KX-iQa439YPkfRBgeZ9t5GtPRus6_XJ-1RXEUgAXBkv46PuCKJ6JV24IT-iYa1pgRh2vQDAPyiLryrNMNB7fQ4lsKteh0NfXYICNfD79UgQHxTzCJ6n2TUSFYeMYz6pRd6-Z6IoX1_yQ5AY5I3aiYNy4tMar--1uDHrA20q7WwX8rrkeQvxUegbQDEwRXe6qx6Zwi0NhnqAMW47VvU-NUOA%3D%3D)

* * *
My name is Nick Wilson, I was born and raised in California. I am not a politician, nor do I come from a political family. I am a husband to a supportive wife, and the proud father of an amazing 8-year-old son. body:
My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

| | | My fellow Americans - this is Mike Johnson.

_**[This is a longer email but I'm humbly asking you to read it start to finish.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c7b86d96e8a74885955eaabe6e230ebb&_e=yi0Zoixe0trIjA7d2J8aWmTkLqPXveasn8n7qJgpX8EbtIpRMWL9ZSX3cZhxKlmV0XbSFeUcnLV5G0NjiKwhn15S7VAQYMxff6Zj2XJAjxwykn7t6byH4O7M1dpcamb_adDRYamcBMLnq9aUrd1RlyPmgt-mdrEP7nU_p1r9JaLorG7MYyKn7K97sXGQxDVmh9_Ba0MBMX9GhFf3mb0ndskXU-LZodQMB6E1qm2C2w5uzBbzqXZq12SsyrHS6RkPcNB0mx9PelqrtrqgaFxfM19mDIK0eigR5cLay8o7jigDh1qKkshdnhJjPDejETd3uYsvwc6qFrfOcI-bjn31UAp3d7Bg7tmWoiRFhpJixM4al-85kJcGDz1I3X_d0ubuCtn_gN-pl1oGaHY5eZy9FYh4IKJb0-9XaNB7I7CQO-k%3D "This is a longer email but I’m humbly asking you to read it start to finish.")**_

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c7b86d96e8a74885955eaabe6e230ebb&_e=yi0Zoixe0trIjA7d2J8aWmTkLqPXveasn8n7qJgpX8EbtIpRMWL9ZSX3cZhxKlmV0XbSFeUcnLV5G0NjiKwhn15S7VAQYMxff6Zj2XJAjxwykn7t6byH4O7M1dpcamb_adDRYamcBMLnq9aUrd1RlyPmgt-mdrEP7nU_p1r9JaLorG7MYyKn7K97sXGQxDVmh9_Ba0MBMX9GhFf3mb0ndskXU-LZodQMB6E1qm2C2w5uzBbzqXZq12SsyrHS6RkPcNB0mx9PelqrtrqgaFxfM8pVaWq1i48WfNmgfkSrEElhQnWT6ZFpp9ZuUDsgch0I4poPrVkaNQoCr4Wk8jMPMQJHLbUCfXiLvmrG73NCFLCa1CnBCrSAIavIHdzq-qne7s718TVUaYd-6pgkXFWdcjPm553DXIuCpwwDdqSgqhs%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

This week, we watched as the Texas Supreme Court denied Kate Cox, a mother of two facing health-threatening pregnancy complications, the right to terminate her pregnancy. The fetus she was carrying tested positive for a fatal condition that posed serious risks to Ms. Cox’s future fertility, and Cox was already experiencing alarming health complications requiring multiple trips to the emergency room. Yet a group of partisan judges with no medical training ruled that Ms. Cox did not meet the threshold for a medical emergency exemption [https://www.cnn.com/2023/12/11/us/texas-woman-leaves-state-abortion/index.html] to receive an abortion.

Access to healthcare should never be determined by the courts. Every person has the right to make decisions about their own body, their own health, and their own future.

Tell Congress: Protect reproductive rights. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/protect-reproductive-rights?contactdata=8lEhhIvn6S0pIQgdcjqhZHko92/NI8EJuuuhCbwdCC3zyEtGVRYiWcGhlWrEBgUMIVZlIQDlfpUbKgz9iktskhi7kNttGmLGMSTAjuLYkTjsmqAAOq1uPNo+Q+v6YyDLFX+GnLpinC31ZhAHiU5rTA==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1734586012888695132?s=20 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1734586012888695132?s=20]

These abortion bans not only deny bodily autonomy, but they put lives at risk. Republicans continue to uphold their extreme abortion policies, including opposing exceptions even for rape or life-threatening conditions, which not even Ronald Reagan or George W. Bush believed. Women who can afford it will sometimes have to travel through several states and pay thousands of dollars to terminate a pregnancy or risk imprisonment.

Access to abortion care is a fundamental right, one we must protect at all costs. Sign if you agree: Congress must codify Roe v. Wade . [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/protect-reproductive-rights?contactdata=8lEhhIvn6S0pIQgdcjqhZHko92/NI8EJuuuhCbwdCC3zyEtGVRYiWcGhlWrEBgUMIVZlIQDlfpUbKgz9iktskhi7kNttGmLGMSTAjuLYkTjsmqAAOq1uPNo+Q+v6YyDLFX+GnLpinC31ZhAHiU5rTA==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

| | Peter,

It's official—we're running unopposed!

I'm proud to have entered the race to represent our District 5 communities once again on the San Mateo County Board of Supervisor. Now, this is when we begin the process of bringing our grassroots coalition to new heights.

_**In these early stages, your support can help power the initial rounds of contact that get this campaign season rolling. There are going to be Democrats up and down the ballot that are counting on grassroots backing to make an impact.**_

[_**Peter, this process of reaching folks is going to take significant resources, and preparing now is key to staying on track as the race heats up. With your grassroots support, we can head into 2024 feeling confident that our work on the Board can continue. Can you help us celebrate our entry into the race by donating today?**_](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=1d65cd1c54&e=0961f0e7e8)

---
| We've seen the importance of having a Supervisor with connections to the areas they represent.

When Daly City's Seton Medical Center was facing imminent closure, the threats to our community were clear. The hospital was our largest employer, and served thousands each year, many of whom were elderly or low-income._**If the hospital closed, Daly City would have become a healthcare desert, forcing people to drive further for medical care and reducing access for low-income patients.**_

We as a community were not willing to accept this. We rallied together and secured funding for the hospital through the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors.

_**None of this would have been possible without people like you and me standing up to advocate for our communities.**_

[_**Peter, we're entering this race with the needs of District 5 front and center. Together, we can continue advocating for the policies that make San Mateo County the best place to raise your family. Can you help us fight for District 5 up and down the ballot by donating today?**_](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=12db80bf64&e=0961f0e7e8)

David Canepa

| | | | David Canepa is running for re-election to the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors to continue providing county residents with the resources and tools necessary to create a community that is healthy, environmentally conscious, equitable and economically prosperous.

As a fourth generation son of San Mateo County and graduate of Skyline College, David cares deeply about the residents of San Mateo County, as he has lived and worked in this community his entire life.

[](https://davidcanepa.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46c1d4af8f9db208806c0d78a&id=ff7e95115d&e=0961f0e7e8)

David is a proud fourth-generation San Mateo County and lives in Daly City with his family.

| | | Dear Friend,
---
My legal team has filed our closing argument brief in the California State Bar trial seeking to have me disbarred as a lawyer. This has been a surreal, exhausting battle to defend my integrity and legal actions from an onslaught of false charges leveled by radical leftwing lawyers working with lawfare groups. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter,
Today, I am honored to extend my warmest wishes and heartfelt congratulations to the brave men and women of the National Guard as we celebrate their 387th birthday.

As we reflect on the storied history of the National Guard, we are reminded of the selfless dedication and unwavering commitment displayed by its members throughout the years. From responding to natural disasters and civil emergencies to deploying overseas in defense of our nation, the National Guard has consistently demonstrated the highest levels of courage, resilience, and patriotism.

This birthday serves as a momentous occasion to express our deepest gratitude to the National Guard for their tireless service and sacrifice. Whether serving on the front lines during times of crisis or providing critical support in communities across the country, the National Guard plays an integral role in safeguarding the well-being of our nation and its citizens.

I want to take this opportunity to acknowledge the incredible contributions of our local National Guard units, whose members embody the spirit of service and the values that make our community strong. Their commitment to duty, honor, and country serves as an inspiration to us all.

As your representative in Congress, I remain dedicated to advocating for the resources and support needed to ensure the National Guard continues to fulfill its vital mission. Our collective commitment to standing by those who stand for us is a testament to the strength and unity of our great nation.

On this special day, let us join together in expressing our gratitude and appreciation for the National Guard's exceptional service to our community and our country. May the coming year bring continued success, growth, and prosperity to the National Guard as they embark on another year of service to the United States of America.

Happy 387th birthday, National Guard!

clean_body: | | | | Peter, Today, I am honored to extend my warmest wishes and heartfelt congratulations to the brave men and women of the National Guard as we celebrate their 387th birthday. As we reflect on the storied history of the National Guard, we are reminded of the selfless dedication and unwavering commitment displayed by its members throughout the years. From responding to natural disasters and civil emergencies to deploying overseas in defense of our nation, the National Guard has consistently demonstrated the highest levels of courage, resilience, and patriotism. This birthday serves as a momentous occasion to express our deepest gratitude to the National Guard for their tireless service and sacrifice. Whether serving on the front lines during times of crisis or providing critical support in communities across the country, the National Guard plays an integral role in safeguarding the well-being of our nation and its citizens. I want to take this opportunity to acknowledge the incredible contributions of our local National Guard units, whose members embody the spirit of service and the values that make our community strong. Their commitment to duty, honor, and country serves as an inspiration to us all. As your representative in Congress, I remain dedicated to advocating for the resources and support needed to ensure the National Guard continues to fulfill its vital mission. Our collective commitment to standing by those who stand for us is a testament to the strength and unity of our great nation. On this special day, let us join together in expressing our gratitude and appreciation for the National Guard's exceptional service to our community and our country. May the coming year bring continued success, growth, and prosperity to the National Guard as they embark on another year of service to the United States of America. Happy 387th birthday, National Guard! Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. | Hi there,

We previously emailed you to let you know that **youth turnout in November DOUBLED on college campuses** compared to the last time there was an open Supreme Court seat.

We are so proud of this stat because this past fall, the affiliated C3 organization, New PA Project Education Fund, conducted non-partisan voter registration and civic education on campuses across Pennsylvania. In a single weekend blitz at Penn State University in Centre County, the New PA Project Education Fund collected 420 voter registration forms!

**Here’s the thing:** _ABC News_ recently reported that issues, not candidates, are motivating youth voters to turn out to the polls. In fact, a CIRCLE analysis found that 59% of voters under 30 said top-of-the-ticket candidates “were ‘not a factor’ in their vote in 2022, more than any other age group.” Their top priorities were the issues they cared about, such as gun safety, climate change, and reproductive freedom.

[**We are no stranger to this fact. That’s why we already center youth in our work and listen to hear what issues matter most to them. Help us continue to engage and activate young voters by donating $25 today →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75107785/443625686/1843371473?refcode=EM_F_231213young_N_TN_90DO_7_NG_TestA_L1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcyMmQ3Njg0LWUxOTktZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=MDTeJrih3TZCEQvbuYTuhUzRuihh7C8eltRSUT_BDYs=)

That’s why we always center youth (17-35) in our work to ensure they embrace their power and turn out to vote.

Next year, we will once again be out on the ground conducting voter registration and civic education at college campuses, and universities all across Pennsylvania. Dear Fellow Patriot,

Insane leftist policies threaten to destroy our country. Leftist policies cause open borders, rampant corruption, rising crime, and the erasing of American freedom. And the corporate media refuses to cover these failures and instead push their own leftist narratives. Americans are fed up with the lack of action to fix these problems and save our crumbling republic.

But the fight isn't lost.

The Heritage Foundation has developed four key initiatives to defeat the leftist agenda and tackle these critical issues head on.

**Through Project 2025 we 've devised a plan to dismantle the deep state** by training thousands of patriotic Americans to staff the next presidential administration, enact conservative policy solutions, and replace the deep state's leftist bureaucrats.

**We 're taking on government corruption through the Heritage Oversight Project**. Our expert team of lawyers and investigators are in the trenches, filing lawsuits and Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the D.C. swamp's wrongdoings and hold perpetrators accountable.

**We 're working to end Biden's open borders** by developing key public policy solutions that will secure America's borders. Just this year, The Heritage Foundation's research was pivotal to the House-passed Secure the Border Act.

And through our **Election Integrity Scorecard** , we're holding state policymakers accountable by ranking the security and integrity of each state's election laws and procedures. Governors and state policymakers contact our team frequently looking for ways to improve their score.

All of these projects will defeat leftist policies and bring about success for our country next year. But I need your support to get them over the finish line.

# _The Key to the American Dream is Georgia’s Small Businesses!_
Friend, Georgia's small businesses are the lifeblood of our economy, representing the entrepreneurial spirit that has defined the American Dream for generations. However, the current administration's misguided economic policies are crushing these enterprises and jeopardizing the dreams of countless business owners.
Democrats and D.C. elites don’t feel the crunch of rising taxes, grocery prices and inflation like we have for the past few years; but they insist that our economy has never been stronger and that we, hard-working taxpayers, are wrong. And I’ve had enough of them lying to our faces.
With my experience in running businesses and serving as a hospital director, I know how to help Georgian businesses thrive! It’s high time that “We the People” remind D.C. that we will not give up on the American Dream we were promised and will make it a reality!

| | | Dear Friend,
---
My legal team has filed our closing argument brief in the California State Bar trial seeking to have me disbarred as a lawyer. This has been a surreal, exhausting battle to defend my integrity and legal actions from an onslaught of false charges leveled by radical leftwing lawyers working with lawfare groups. Tragically, many of these false charges were repeated nearly word-for-word by State Bar prosecutors and form the basis of the Bar's prosecution against me. It took months of preparation by me and my legal team to be ready for this trial, which took up an incredible ten weeks of testimony. My legal team has demolished the State Bar's claim that there was no evidence of fraud or illegality in the 2020 elections. Our team put on a wide array of credible witnesses that, for the first time, laid bare in a courtroom many of the illegal and fraudulent activities that occurred in critical states such as Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona and Pennsylvania. It was a constant battle even to present our witnesses as State Bar prosecutors repeatedly objected to evidence we sought to present. Nonetheless, our team did a magnificent job and made a clear and compelling case that my representation of President Trump had a strong factual basis as well as a compelling legal basis under the law and constitution. The State Bar Court judge has ninety days to publish her decision and put forth any recommendation on discipline she might seek the Bar to impose. But that ruling won't be the end of the case. The decision can be appealed through the State Bar judicial process, and then it can go to the California Supreme Court and also possibly to the US Supreme Court for final determination.

| | | Peter, I'm going to let you in on a little secret: Egos in Washington are out of control.

It's a major problem. People in Washington _love_ taking credit for things they didn't do.

Take my election to the Senate for example: Anyone with half a brain knows why I serve in the Senate. It's because of the great people of Missouri. Hard-working people who wanted someone in the Senate who would represent their values. **[I am accountable to God, my family, and the good people of Missouri.](http://email.hawleyformo.com/u/click?_t=11a592fdc01846d4a1c728421295853d&_m=493c9b1031a9424aa74b744bcef136af&_e=C9TFXz-mOtQu6w9SoQzoGJPtsePzflwi5X_chLj2z6k4PokcQ0t51PLFXkGo64cnusxWN5MyaoBMX23ueCdeFxSnSu0yBViIwHledEW__aCYaNjTnD9fvteAHgKmO-P2EGgFjM1Ykzh_JgiQITJGmyP5326KCg1ZYzKhm69fCfXe30tSyhz5OhvtPnuVqEKMn_L502_t04tQwrB2X6js6xzonS6mmMvCEitfLmFIUahTI7RTRxnGKnMNqSRY9Jxkii7zlp89w5dRN5FGq2kN7Tmq61O1wapLD--PQh4R2ToHNBZpm6tT8i7SZsAOzhZA2Q9k646DOaAOi-jv8d0zBRtNnGAnJ2xw-KZX_rQTwsnL2K41lJfCWSKTubjY0YaZ)**

Mitch McConnell came after me in a closed-door meeting because he is _threatened_. Threatened that his decades in Washington building relationships with corporations, expanding his own power, and picking winners and losers in states all across the country could come to a screeching halt.

He’s afraid that everyday people could have more of a say about what happens in their states than he does.

But McConnell and others in Washington are trying to take credit for my election.

They tout their super PACs and their decades in D.C., but they ignore the truth: My campaign was, is, and will always be people first.

Grassroots support is the lifeblood of the conservative movement and the lifeblood of my team. | | Fellow Patriot, I still have nightmares. The horrors of communism are branded into my memory like a hot iron. I fled Vietnam the month the Viet Cong captured Saigon. It's a miracle that you're even reading this. This is CAPT Hung Cao. I'm a combat veteran, immigrant, and conservative who's pissed off at what the radical left has done to our country. The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

That's because today, the deep state controls D.C.

**Regardless of who is in office, career bureaucrats in our federal agencies like the Justice Department, Environmental Protection Agency, and the State Department independently push their own leftist agendas.

The Heritage Foundation has that plan--called Project 2025.

**Through Project 2025, The Heritage Foundation has united 80 conservative organizations and is leading the charge for the next presidential transition plan.**

Heritage's policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we're identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

It’s become increasingly clear just how far GOP mega-donor-funded group
AIPAC is willing to go to try and unseat the Squad in next year’s
Democratic primaries. Rep. Ilhan Omar nailed it:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231213.Tb191t&refcode=em20231213-32313&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=32313%2E1203867%2ElwXTaN ]Tweet from Ilhan Omar: We are up against a far-right movement that: is
funded by Donald Trump’s biggest donors, endorsed over 100
insurrectionists, spent $30M to defeat progressive candidates, is planning
to spend $100M to take out progressive champions. This is corruption,
plain and simple.

AIPAC is corroding our democracy, using hundreds of millions of dollars
from the same donors who support Donald Trump to re-elect Republican
insurrectionists and challenge Democratic incumbents who refuse to do
their bidding — all to defend a foreign government that is committing
horrific human rights abuses from real accountability.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231213.Tb191t&refcode=em20231213-32313&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32313%2E1203867%2ElwXTaN ]The future of our progressive movement and the Democratic Party is at
stake in 2024. Can you pitch in $3 or more today to
directly fuel our fight to protect the Squad against AIPAC in the months
ahead?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231213.Tb191t&refcode=em20231213-32313&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32313%2E1203867%2ElwXTaN ]Contribute $3

If AIPAC had their way, our bloc of young, working-class, Black and brown
progressive champions like Ilhan, Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, Jamaal Bowman,
AOC, and Ayanna Pressley wouldn’t be in Congress fighting for human
rights, Medicare for All, affordable housing, higher wages, and so much
more.

We can’t let them succeed.

— Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32313%2E1203867%2ElwXTaN ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32313%2E1203867%2ElwXTaN ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Peter,

I’m horrified reading the news out of Texas this week. A mother of two children, pregnant with a fetus diagnosed with a fatal condition by her doctor, has been prohibited from getting a medically required abortion by the Texas Supreme Court.

She applied for an exception to Texas’ abortion ban in order to save her life and future fertility. After a lower court granted her request, the Texas Supreme Court suddenly overturned the ruling – leaving her no choice but to flee the state to receive the care she needed.

This story is sickening. **No woman should be forced to fight in court for the right to their own body, and it's shocking that extreme Republicans, like my opponent Mike Garcia who cosponsored the Republicans’ national abortion ban bill, want this to be a reality for all American women.**

I am worried for the future of reproductive rights in this country. My daughter should not have less rights than my wife did at her age, but that’s what’s at stake if extremists like Garcia get their way and pass a nationwide abortion ban.

**[We must codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law to reinstate abortion rights nationwide and women’s bodily autonomy. The government has no place in decisions that should be between women and their doctors. subject: Sign: Tell the Supreme Court to leave abortion pill access alone
body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
# [Tell the Supreme Court: Don't touch abortion pill access!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1f777672-6f77-47a3-bb8c-88babd73be06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T942f3b95-772f-4529-bf96-a92f74ab0e0d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | The Supreme Court just announced it will hear a case challenging access to the drug mifepristone, which is used in combination with misoprostol for medication abortion. This medication is safe and effective – there’s no reason the Supreme Court should restrict access to it! But since they overturned Roe v. Wade over a year ago, reproductive rights are on the chopping block. The Supreme Court’s decision could seriously disrupt reproductive care throughout the country. Since the FDA approved the abortion pill 23 years ago, a majority of American patients now terminate their pregnancies with pills rather than by undergoing a procedure at a clinic. These pills are safe and reliable. We must fight to ensure they stay that way. [Add your name to tell the Supreme Court: Don't touch abortion pill access! >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6d92d989-1866-4490-a7ea-2317ffdcc1cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Those actions are shameful, and the people who aid or enable them are villains or cowards. That’s why, when the most vulnerable Democratic district in Maryland became an open race, I knew I had to step up to ensure that this must-win seat stays blue. I’m an Army veteran who knows democracy is earned through sacrifice. I’ve had enough of politicians who are destroying our democracy. Together we can defeat divisive politics and focus on serving the people, but that requires a movement of grassroots supporters. _Friend: Democracy isn’t a single-player sport, and neither is securing it._ [**If you are in this fight with me, will you please consider pitching in a donation before midnight tomorrow? name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Recently in Puerto Rico
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Highlights from my latest visit with organizers on the island.
#
I just got back from an amazing trip visiting organizers in Puerto Rico.
**Our hope for this trip was to learn about the efforts of, and build community with, the grassroots organizers working for justice across the island.** So many challenges that Puerto Ricans face on a daily basis — lack of affordable housing, food insecurity, dangers of the climate emergency — are identical to the struggles that we face on the mainland. Organizers from VAMOS PR helped us connect with those working on the island so we can learn from each other and build a better world together.
Here are some highlights from the trip...
**We met with regenerative agriculture practitioners and educators fighting to end food insecurity in Puerto Rico.** Local farming was once a mainstay of the island’s economy, but today 85% of Puerto Rico’s food is imported. Grocery store prices are higher than ever — and one third of Puerto Ricans live with food insecurity. We visited two farms trying to change that by restoring a robust local agriculture system.
Ecological educators at Finca El Josco Bravo share free lessons on climate adaptation practices, like using compost to increase the water capacity of soil, so local farmers can adapt to increasingly intense hurricanes and extreme heat driven by the climate crisis.
At Finca Flor de Aji, organizers use regenerative agriculture techniques based in indigenous culture — like rotating crops and integrating livestock and forestry to reduce the need for pesticides on farms — to provide fresh produce across the island, and are advocating to retool the upcoming Farm Bill to support Puerto Rico's farmers so residents can buy nutritious food grown locally.
**We learned a lot about housing justice organizing.** All over Puerto Rico, local people are being displaced by outside developers who raise area prices. In Rio Piedras, organizers reclaimed an abandoned, 100-yr-old building as a space for the community before developers could get to it — using it as a recycling center, shared art studio, and temporary housing for displaced people, all while restoring the building. Now, Paseo 13 is a neighborhood hub. Radical, direct actions like this are happening more and more, as locals come together against opportunistic investors and urban blight.
**We were invited into La Perla, one of PR’s most famous historically closed communities, by organizers working to improve living conditions there.** To be invited into La Perla by locals is an honor, and we are eager to support their work to improve the lives of local families. La Perla is also home to many small businesses and a vibrant history of local art and music — it even has a music production studio for youth in the area to use for free. Organizers are fighting for federal funding to improve La Perla’s infrastructure, reopen a cultural center that served the community for years, restore services in the local clinical center, and rebuild waterfront areas.
**We have so much to learn from our movement’s counterparts in Puerto Rico.** My hope is that we can continue to share insights into how to build the world we’re fighting for, together.
Pa'lante,
Alexandria

clean_body: Highlights from my latest visit with organizers on the island. I just got back from an amazing trip visiting organizers in Puerto Rico. Our hope for this trip was to learn about the efforts of, and build community with, the grassroots organizers working for justice across the island. So many challenges that Puerto Ricans face on a daily basis — lack of affordable housing, food insecurity, dangers of the climate emergency — are identical to the struggles that we face on the mainland. Organizers from VAMOS PR helped us connect with those working on the island so we can learn from each other and build a better world together. Here are some highlights from the trip... We met with regenerative agriculture practitioners and educators fighting to end food insecurity in Puerto Rico. Local farming was once a mainstay of the island’s economy, but today 85% of Puerto Rico’s food is imported. Grocery store prices are higher than ever — and one third of Puerto Ricans live with food insecurity. We visited two farms trying to change that by restoring a robust local agriculture system. Ecological educators at Finca El Josco Bravo share free lessons on climate adaptation practices, like using compost to increase the water capacity of soil, so local farmers can adapt to increasingly intense hurricanes and extreme heat driven by the climate crisis. At Finca Flor de Aji, organizers use regenerative agriculture techniques based in indigenous culture — like rotating crops and integrating livestock and forestry to reduce the need for pesticides on farms — to provide fresh produce across the island, and are advocating to retool the upcoming Farm Bill to support Puerto Rico's farmers so residents can buy nutritious food grown locally. We learned a lot about housing justice organizing. All over Puerto Rico, local people are being displaced by outside developers who raise area prices. In Rio Piedras, organizers reclaimed an abandoned, 100-yr-old building as a space for the community before developers could get to it — using it as a recycling center, shared art studio, and temporary housing for displaced people, all while restoring the building. Now, Paseo 13 is a neighborhood hub. Radical, direct actions like this are happening more and more, as locals come together against opportunistic investors and urban blight. We were invited into La Perla, one of PR’s most famous historically closed communities, by organizers working to improve living conditions there. To be invited into La Perla by locals is an honor, and we are eager to support their work to improve the lives of local families. La Perla is also home to many small businesses and a vibrant history of local art and music — it even has a music production studio for youth in the area to use for free. Organizers are fighting for federal funding to improve La Perla’s infrastructure, reopen a cultural center that served the community for years, restore services in the local clinical center, and rebuild waterfront areas. We have so much to learn from our movement’s counterparts in Puerto Rico. My hope is that we can continue to share insights into how to build the world we’re fighting for, together. Pa'lante, Alexandria | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.
