Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. My husband saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. **[Now I hope you can see why I’m asking you to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SRYpyZJO0hXCVAm89x5lLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnXKZKP0SXaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi80YTMxN2JjNi1iZTFiLTRhMDgtYjk1OC1iNGNkYTAwZmMyYzI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMjEzX0JER19MRUxERl9EUFBTUF9SRU5fUEEtVVNDTlcDc3BjQgplc7j_eWVsGhxNUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** When Jason Johnson at the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) told me they would continue to fight for Eric’s freedom, I was able to take my first deep breath in days. If you’ve heard of LELDF, then you already know they’re a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like my husband. LELDF has helped dozens of men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.It’s such a comfort knowing there are pro-police patriots like Jason at the team and LELDF......but without your urgent action today, Eric will be locked in prison for the next 6 years... 6 Thanksgivings, 6 Christmas, and 6 New Years... 6 birthdays for each child... 6 wedding anniversaries... I still can’t wrap my mind around the full magnitude of what this miscarriage of justice means for my family. I just know every time I think about the future without the man I love – the father of my children – my heart cracks more. **[That’s why I’m urgently asking you to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SRYpyZJO0hXCVAm89x5lLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnXKZKP0SXaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi80YTMxN2JjNi1iZTFiLTRhMDgtYjk1OC1iNGNkYTAwZmMyYzI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMjEzX0JER19MRUxERl9EUFBTUF9SRU5fUEEtVVNDTlcDc3BjQgplc7j_eWVsGhxNUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison!The reality is we can’t get back the last few weeks Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has hanging over our heads.But with your help today, we can bring my husband home in time to enjoy the holidays with his three children.**[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SRYpyZJO0hXCVAm89x5lLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnXKZKP0SXaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi80YTMxN2JjNi1iZTFiLTRhMDgtYjk1OC1iNGNkYTAwZmMyYzI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMjEzX0JER19MRUxERl9EUFBTUF9SRU5fUEEtVVNDTlcDc3BjQgplc7j_eWVsGhxNUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of 12 officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric because of the generosity of patriots like you. Friend, to say it’s been a difficult few years for our family would be an understatement. But with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/SRYpyZJO0hXCVAm89x5lLg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnXKZKP0SXaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi80YTMxN2JjNi1iZTFiLTRhMDgtYjk1OC1iNGNkYTAwZmMyYzI_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMxMjEzX0JER19MRUxERl9EUFBTUF9SRU5fUEEtVVNDTlcDc3BjQgplc7j_eWVsGhxNUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Thank you in advance for your continued prayers and support.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
Sarah DeValkenaere

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

Peter,

Recently, I received an email from **former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana**. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - _**it’s compelling.**_

Best Regards,
Kellyanne Conway

\--------------------------------------------
**From:** Tim Sheehy
**Date:** Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM
**To:** Kellyanne Conway
**Subject:** The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul

Kellyanne,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e7e0d12a9ba843b49d0e2cef9ec84d39&_e=6Dp8zFEWgrOxAJ8TOswwQrXajRkkzw3gr2HThwbs1cySwMyUCBybHqD30WprXuzKPS2o3NTNjh4a229vV1GTsgaBOIWd44XKeVZtWuzHHa3CTsAgO1CVLHgCizLjHN9Xj-_tgfxP10DmbRLy28GPoe5kGxuq5R4i7W8Y41OnBBYNR0neQhph-d-vKAeBjJ5rkoVcuYT8OagQu063tGsbhEr9f_tjOGqBfcSOlgQaGrpHothBRp8dO-dlbQ29vfLLkDsvZVWT0lOk7a5vu__q2WTwfs_9bSa7-sfQUNDmzXecRVAwjNXKIdhX4FHNZ41ELgNlpKTA1gslMcEMqieFgeY0cmeedxaeILxk3_01ja_5Q8uYimFYNrTUhfsIamkiW8cnPaub66N5nhBHV7FRxFg0c6QoSDy3BdbCbW0lu2o%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e7e0d12a9ba843b49d0e2cef9ec84d39&_e=6Dp8zFEWgrOxAJ8TOswwQrXajRkkzw3gr2HThwbs1cySwMyUCBybHqD30WprXuzKPS2o3NTNjh4a229vV1GTsgaBOIWd44XKeVZtWuzHHa3CTsAgO1CVLHgCizLjHN9Xj-_tgfxP10DmbRLy28GPoe5kGxuq5R4i7W8Y41OnBBYNR0neQhph-d-vKAeBjJ5rkoVcuYT8OagQu063tGsbhEr9f_tjOGqBfcSOlgQaGrpHothBRp8dO-dlbQ29vfLLkDsvZVWT0lOk7a5vu__q2VuyPmKBlVbtD_1ma6RmT80uvR1VCCP0pY7EUy0buTodm2TcCDReqqdLIfZI6sMKIJ1j3QlB3IY3LwkiyW29tgbNd8oyZWTV6g1hZBptzsxbols0nuHKD2kMTswTCSEW_da5VPu459vY8sfDPwUd_n0%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

Fellow Conservative,

Recently, I received an email from **former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana**. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - _**it’s compelling.**_

Best Regards,
Kellyanne Conway

\--------------------------------------------
**From:** Tim Sheehy
**Date:** Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM
**To:** Kellyanne Conway
**Subject:** The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul

Kellyanne,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=689c7e579d26463fb87e2483e1281fec&_e=aR12P6EWER7_9RpPY8SOUhNuLLTzI07joj9gTq2-wQ4sINn4OCQuwTdnMsduoVkTUBH4XwD2LWlT-oNVLoKnN1ckTub-SzI9iGnmyMqvamkTxtttAhocHfCliHbGadlrc8sCFkdo18gvcP1TDnidraEAecrqv1MNG7DSBlmssAdxxAS1s2Y4flkKeZhYB_NZwy3AEvjhemPYygO3pomjj8vUyL0hu56_msZOv06uqNcSJW1HR_C4qlTcbV1nckoyND5SSs6cgRHvNwIaMN8DL1aNwU9TxzMFfYWcnpdNeQq-spUkoD1xbiN751QnId0cJyNRiPUrFwnce3_vqX1v99IPX0DvRwiklZN6mv-Qd98Vsz6A5YGR5COHl034BzMZnl9T3wyZWldj1Np7bpdniLxM7F7yIuXYk-t0CVIF_xY%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=689c7e579d26463fb87e2483e1281fec&_e=aR12P6EWER7_9RpPY8SOUhNuLLTzI07joj9gTq2-wQ4sINn4OCQuwTdnMsduoVkTUBH4XwD2LWlT-oNVLoKnN1ckTub-SzI9iGnmyMqvamkTxtttAhocHfCliHbGadlrc8sCFkdo18gvcP1TDnidraEAecrqv1MNG7DSBlmssAdxxAS1s2Y4flkKeZhYB_NZwy3AEvjhemPYygO3pomjj8vUyL0hu56_msZOv06uqNcSJW1HR_C4qlTcbV1nckoyND5SSs6cgRHvNwIaMN8DL6pnJ4Ah3rfVB-CXWn68Iw6w1BUMQaHb0hOi95bOP0S_AbQFf_962-YQ4n470QoOOxez6fAAWAtQRzUqZSWVQF_p3L_cx_URwbmANh7jh6fRYq3Asq7ET1O_H5IVE9aQYvgazOfrzEyI_5GV8DxL4SY%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=689c7e579d26463fb87e2483e1281fec&_e=aR12P6EWER7_9RpPY8SOUhNuLLTzI07joj9gTq2-wQ4sINn4OCQuwTdnMsduoVkTeeEOohMt7sJ6g3rXeyArLdDtcXeb923PXcb3OB-sRva2441PfW-RDbD6OEkaTTYh328IEcTvk_PxZletqN6WkE2PyodbfWe7AhHFywc1KYRbchE5azWrWmwKp2rV5xeFW-WPKumq9YRufb14LSm1WhvdHlvnYDWPGa-HzHL2-wTSFnHh_Cbpde57o9jtQjKlzWo5-FDLVMH-l9gxI6GqWIJJ142z_9tVHsmkvqWxBT7UiO5_hcTa6MHxVM-uI6OWxGW9dBJB9B298o9ff1JooKbG2BhYT9ra7H7k0yb00Y3CRHsvNICPKzJzu530JAyCuUTJoTZSlx7-EdELMEFHN7AE8ljQDfrjUrmD_sJOMuY%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=689c7e579d26463fb87e2483e1281fec&_e=aR12P6EWER7_9RpPY8SOUhNuLLTzI07joj9gTq2-wQ4sINn4OCQuwTdnMsduoVkTUBH4XwD2LWlT-oNVLoKnN1ckTub-SzI9iGnmyMqvamkTxtttAhocHfCliHbGadlrc8sCFkdo18gvcP1TDnidraEAecrqv1MNG7DSBlmssAdxxAS1s2Y4flkKeZhYB_NZwy3AEvjhemPYygO3pomjj8vUyL0hu56_msZOv06uqNcSJW1HR_C4qlTcbV1nckoyND5SSs6cgRHvNwIaMN8DL-3rgwO6tbvJeLARqRb6lqCp2D6ap8HGsL9LKa6qg0BrjoHf2VclOb9Cg3KGCoPiVnYvvHntfiFVuc3XPMuErxBVAV-tkV66Mwcanh96hKPlnBfzPBNs21BKulecQMp3J8y2x_kGrX44k6lmiro-sd4%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
And it’s seldom for good reason.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75119292/443665826/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmYyZDIwNDEtZmY5OS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PALQuR-MWcPg2YttpwE_qLTW7qWxyHjGhiRN8ktcoc4=&emci=4b883584-f199-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=ff2d2041-ff99-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
A few months ago, we talked to you about the rise of the dark-money political group, No Labels and its deceptive messaging. Well, they’re back in the news and it’s hardly ever for good reason. Check it out below: ⬇️
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75119296/443665830/230009872?refcode=em20231213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmYyZDIwNDEtZmY5OS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PALQuR-MWcPg2YttpwE_qLTW7qWxyHjGhiRN8ktcoc4=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75119297/443665833/230009872?refcode=em20231213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmYyZDIwNDEtZmY5OS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PALQuR-MWcPg2YttpwE_qLTW7qWxyHjGhiRN8ktcoc4=)
In recent months, the group has received attention for its “unity ticket” concept — running a moderate Democrat and Republican on the same ticket — that has garnered renewed interest with the recent announcement of Sen. Joe Manchin’s retirement from the Senate, coupled with Manchin’s aspirations for higher office.
Peter, mainstream media might be afraid to call out No Labels, but COURIER isn't. Whether it's standing up to Fox News or pulling back the curtain about No Labels, our work to expose misinformation and provide trustworthy reporting during the 2024 presidential campaign is more important than ever.
**[We’ll explain more about the threat No Labels poses to the 2024 election in just a moment, but if you don’t have the time to read, can you chip in anything you can so we can reach our $7,500 mid-month fundraising goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75119298/443665834/230009872?refcode=em20231213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmYyZDIwNDEtZmY5OS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PALQuR-MWcPg2YttpwE_qLTW7qWxyHjGhiRN8ktcoc4=)**
Here are three key facts explaining why No Labels is _not_ a centrist party, why _no_ third party can win the White House, and who's really behind these efforts.
**First, the group's basic premise doesn't comport with reality.** They claim that Trump and Biden represent equally extreme ends of the political spectrum, ignoring the fact that Trump openly sought the end of American democracy and is now promising his base "retribution" over the election he falsely claims was stolen. **An equivalent extreme simply _does not exist_ on the American left.**
**Second, the Electoral College makes a third-party victory virtually impossible.** In 1912, 1992, 2000, and 2016, third-party candidates siphoned enough votes to tip the scales in favor of one of the major party candidates.
In 2024, Trump’s core base will support him no matter what — a third-party candidate would only serve to splinter traditionally conservative voters concerned with the state of our democracy away from President Biden.
**Third, No Labels is financed by far-right donors.** Although they've repeatedly refused to disclose their major donors, Politico, Mother Jones, and the Lincoln Project have reported that they include:
* **Harlan Crow,** the right-wing billionaire who has lavished Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas with gifts and free vacations.
* **Michael Smith,** a fossil fuel billionaire who has backed a Mitch McConnell super PAC and Virginia’s Republican governor Glenn Youngkin.
* **Allan Keen,** a Florida real estate mogul and longtime Republican donor who spent at least $135,000 to reelect Trump in 2020.

These donors and others are spending huge sums to launder their talking points through a purportedly “centrist” organization. Still, a little digging reveals exactly what No Labels really is: **just another cog in the right-wing disinformation machine.**
**COURIER was founded to call this kind of misinformation out and provide fact-based reporting to communities in battleground states across the country. And _none_ of our work is locked behind a paywall — which means we count exclusively on donors like you to help us accomplish our mission.**
[**As the 2024 election approaches, our work is going to get busier, and your donations will be critical to helping us keep it up. Please pitch in anything you can today to help us reach our $7,500 mid-month fundraising goal.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75119299/443665835/230009872?refcode=em20231213&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmYyZDIwNDEtZmY5OS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PALQuR-MWcPg2YttpwE_qLTW7qWxyHjGhiRN8ktcoc4=)

name: Katie Porter
subject: Sorting through the scam of political emails
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34718%2E3422442%2E4Wq7e4)
As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails. Emails that try to shame or terrify you into donating aren’t my style.
You’ve probably seen emails that say things like:
* “We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” This is fake. We have goals and deadlines, and donations from different parts of the state or country can signal support, but there’s no crazy math like this happening.
* “Donate $5 today and it will be triple matched.” I promise nobody is really doing this.
* “Warning: Payment incomplete.” I despise these misleading emails that make you think you’ve missed a bill. Invoking this type of fear in people is unacceptable.

I’ve introduced legislation to crackdown on scam PACs, who can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are political organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures go solely to “consultants” rather than real causes, and it’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
Here’s what is real: our fundraising deadlines and the facts we give you about this race. There is urgency, yes, because we’re less than three months to Election Day, **and our Federal Election Commission end of quarter deadline is on December 31st.**
Our end of quarter deadlines are some of the most important, as we have to publicly report how much we raise every three months. **But our monthly and even weekly internal goals help us hit those quarterly goals, and as Election Day nears, each week’s fundraising has a big effect on the race.**
Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! **[Can you make a contribution ahead of our federal fundraising deadline on December 31st?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231213-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_FND_20231213_V1_F&refcode2=34718_3422442_4Wq7e4&akid=34718%2E3422442%2E4Wq7e4)**
[Contribute ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231213-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_FND_20231213_V1_F&refcode2=34718_3422442_4Wq7e4&akid=34718%2E3422442%2E4Wq7e4)
Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting our campaign.
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAO23_1_FND_20231213_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=34718_3422442_4Wq7e4&akid=34718%2E3422442%2E4Wq7e4)**

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

In 1985, alongside the other Founding Mothers of EMILYs List, I set an ambitious goal: To build a network of _at least_ _1,000 members_ committed to our mission of electing qualified Democratic pro-choice women to every level of office. And this cycle, early support from this community helped power critical wins in battleground states like Virginia. Without the support, courage, and determination of pro-choice supporters like you, Peter, _none_ of this would have been possible.

Yesterday, I spoke on the floor of the House of Representatives about right-wing attacks on reproductive health care in our country. Earlier this week, the Texas Supreme Court ruled that a 31-year-old mother of two was not entitled to an abortion deemed by her physician as medically necessary.

Government officials – including judges and even presidents – have no business determining if and when people can make personal decisions regarding their reproductive care. That’s why, over a year after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, I am still fighting in Congress to codify abortion rights.
The GOP is denying people life-saving care, and it’s despicable. I promise you that, as long as I remain in Congress, I will continue to fight for equitable, accessible reproductive care for everyone.

clean_body: Earlier this week, the Texas Supreme Court ruled that a 31-year-old mother of two was not entitled to an abortion deemed by her physician as medically necessary. Hi Peter, Yesterday, I spoke on the floor of the House of Representatives about right-wing attacks on reproductive health care in our country. Earlier this week, the Texas Supreme Court ruled that a 31-year-old mother of two was not entitled to an abortion deemed by her physician as medically necessary. This story is heartbreaking, Peter. The mother, Kate Cox, ultimately chose to travel to another state to receive her life-saving care, but many others do not have this option. Government officials – including judges and even presidents – have no business determining if and when people can make personal decisions regarding their reproductive care. That’s why, over a year after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade, I am still fighting in Congress to codify abortion rights. The GOP is denying people life-saving care, and it’s despicable. I promise you that, as long as I remain in Congress, I will continue to fight for equitable, accessible reproductive care for everyone. Here are the stakes in 2024: If we continue to elect extremists to Congress, and if we lose the White House, Republicans will pass a nationwide abortion ban. We can’t let that happen. If you’re with me, I hope you’ll consider supporting my re-election campaign with a donation. No matter who the GOP nominates for President — twice-impeached, can-barely-even-count-how-many-times-indicted Donald Trump, or one of his enablers — it’s clear that the Republican party has chosen a path of dangerous extremism and is spreading it up and down the ballot and across the country. We cannot go down that path with them.

If MAGA Republicans take back more power, they’ll further restrict the right to an abortion nationwide, the freedom to vote, and protections for trans people. They’ll threaten Social Security and Medicare, reward the rich and powerful, and embolden an extremist base across the country. That means strengthening our democracy and protecting voting rights. That means defending LGBTQ+ rights. But here’s the way I see it: This critical election is not only about fighting back against MAGA extremism. We must also rip out the root causes of the deep problems in our economy, our government, and our democracy. The problems that existed way before Donald Trump rode down that elevator in 2015. **So I'll be direct: We’re up against a lot of problems right now. I’m asked this every day!

Columnist Scott Bennett is looking at the same numbers we are, and has concluded, based on the national poll data, that, **yes, “Robert F. Kennedy Jr. can win.”**
I couldn’t agree more. As I meet with hundreds of people every day across this country, the excitement for new leadership is palpable!

Another poll shows Kennedy pulling ahead of both major party contenders among voters under 45 in several key battleground states. This is a significant breakthrough._
---
_Unexpectedly, Americans are becoming aware that 2024 could be a three-way race: An independent candidate could potentially upset the two-party hammerlock on power._
_But is this a surprise? Joe Biden and Donald Trump are hugely unpopular. According to 538, a majority of Americans holds an unfavorable view of both candidates: 54% for Biden, same for Trump. To say that the people are not jazzed about a replay of the 2020 election is supreme understatement. In contrast, more view Kennedy favorably than unfavorably._
Since that poll was taken, an even more reliable poll was taken by the New York Times and Seneca College showing our campaign at 24% – making this a three-man race.
We need only 4.5% from Biden, and 4.5% from Trump, **_to be sworn in the next President of the United States_**.
We’re that close.
But we need your help–in the form of a contribution–for our campaign to appear on the ballot in all 50 states. We’re also in a fourth quarter push to raise $6,000,000 by midnight on December 31.

clean_body: We’re that close. | | | | We’re that close. | | Dear Peter, Can I win? I’m asked this every day! And the answer, according to the Fair Observer , is "Of Course". Columnist Scott Bennett is looking at the same numbers we are, and has concluded, based on the national poll data, that, yes, “Robert F. Kennedy Jr. can win.” I couldn’t agree more. As I meet with hundreds of people every day across this country, the excitement for new leadership is palpable! | And Bennett rightly pointed to our amazing polling data: | A recent Quinnipiac poll showed Kennedy with a surprising 22% share of the electorate in a head-to-head matchup against Joe Biden and Donald Trump. Another poll shows Kennedy pulling ahead of both major party contenders among voters under 45 in several key battleground states. This is a significant breakthrough. Unexpectedly, Americans are becoming aware that 2024 could be a three-way race: An independent candidate could potentially upset the two-party hammerlock on power. But is this a surprise? Joe Biden and Donald Trump are hugely unpopular. According to 538, a majority of Americans holds an unfavorable view of both candidates: 54% for Biden, same for Trump. To say that the people are not jazzed about a replay of the 2020 election is supreme understatement. In contrast, more view Kennedy favorably than unfavorably. Since that poll was taken, an even more reliable poll was taken by the New York Times and Seneca College showing our campaign at 24% – making this a three-man race. We need only 4.5% from Biden, and 4.5% from Trump, to be sworn in the next President of the United States. We’re that close. But we need your help–in the form of a contribution–for our campaign to appear on the ballot in all 50 states. We’re also in a fourth quarter push to raise $6,000,000 by midnight on December 31. The maximum amount you can give is $6,600 – $3,300 for the primary and $3,300 for the general. I know that is a lot of money. | | Sincerely, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. | | | PAID FOR BY TEAM KENNEDY

I've introduced a bill for the US to defund and depart the UN.

**🚨 _Senator Mike Lee Introduces Act to Defund and Depart the UN_ 🚨**

Friend,

No more blank checks for the United Nations. Americans' hard-earned dollars have been funneled into initiatives that fly in the face of our values - **enabling tyrants, betraying allies, and spreading bigotry.**

| [**JOIN ME: DEFUND AND DEPART THE UN**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=dec213cbb3ce4984a640b01cd67664c0&_e=LR9kY3coeoFoyNc4ddDxwuzYKsKbMUg5lPJaG3h5O6doTqdtmcr0StU80jxRVGmOzuC1dDe0p9tmDTG71HO-l-wUmKUHFJokxMBeWLcVtsUlQlVlHofwRol2tJyB0X8lqB7vh2c1jzgq6i8yYqwnys9cU37DrX1lTj1EBcnhxz1ZiBAHm0a50BhNAoahQXepfWtNkHikKx473_9bbXYp3APD2eLg9gdOxpOj24BbryjEH3P_FbR-Iy7JGQZntPVhqcg5H4nRPBrOF7y96g0KEQSs5n1lnBnR8UD2mpIhrQDlVVfbyFVz7RGCjoYW3qwfOShbKU7n3CflwH-24IlxVB2c1zCIyAOGuf7WD6HrM4k%3D)

The world watched Hamas commit heinous, brutal, and disturbing war crimes against innocent civilians and children. The UN's response? _They refused to condemn their actions._

I've had enough, and it's why I've called for the United States to officially stop sending American funds over IMMEDIATELY. **_[Are you with me?](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=dec213cbb3ce4984a640b01cd67664c0&_e=LR9kY3coeoFoyNc4ddDxwuzYKsKbMUg5lPJaG3h5O6doTqdtmcr0StU80jxRVGmOzuC1dDe0p9tmDTG71HO-l-wUmKUHFJokxMBeWLcVtsUlQlVlHofwRol2tJyB0X8lqB7vh2c1jzgq6i8yYqwnys9cU37DrX1lTj1EBcnhxz1ZiBAHm0a50BhNAoahQXepfWtNkHikKx473_9bbXYp3AWAE5V79yk7Zk_gTzXapMutUS46c2aiMYL4YVPBWf8J8LcMuko8ym-U8DR8aK5Jtnk9apiZ8Y_sQoDLEgo_AExYhAgBDdRdFVyB3xh42AXF4T79WaFgn7RJjA7M0UXFW_YhIPJ9H2gu31LCbTqAYUo%3D)_**

[**DEFUND THE UN**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=dec213cbb3ce4984a640b01cd67664c0&_e=LR9kY3coeoFoyNc4ddDxwuzYKsKbMUg5lPJaG3h5O6doTqdtmcr0StU80jxRVGmOzuC1dDe0p9tmDTG71HO-l-wUmKUHFJokxMBeWLcVtsUlQlVlHofwRol2tJyB0X8lqB7vh2c1jzgq6i8yYqwnys9cU37DrX1lTj1EBcnhxz1ZiBAHm0a50BhNAoahQXepfWtNkHikKx473_9bbXYp3BqbH2gPFqJKlsGA6mc3YAmqej9gOFtF36murvYIVHmTOQgW8ZojC9qzX_HPZ8boPKN0tRAATlu8xWl1rpQxisHiijY_VMMfLrxYPgmTnVHmyo1VpYAjTyObGGs2mIqXEysSUxbPnRsN-knHXJcMsW8%3D)

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/TOP.png]
Abortion med is safer than Viagra.
Banning it is an affront to women.
The Supreme Court announced today that it would decide on the availability of a commonly used abortion pill, the first major case involving abortion on its docket since it overturned Roe.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/MF%20Drugs.png]
As family doctor running for Congress, I've been on the frontlines of women's healthcare for four decades, and I will fiercely fight for a woman's right to choose.
Help me get to Congress to be the doctor in the House that helps protect reproductive freedom.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
CONTRIBUTE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=express_lane_5]
CONTRIBUTE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=express_lane_10]
CONTRIBUTE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_ 25]
Friend,
Mifepristone has been used for over 20 years by over five million people. Medical professionals have well-established the medication's safety, and the FDA has followed its mission, federal rules, and regulations.
Commonly prescribed drugs like Penicillin, Tylenol, and Viagra have higher death rates than this abortion medication.
Anti-abortion supporters handpicked the case with an activist juror. They targeted a juror tied to the religious right with anti-abortion views. He issued his opinion on Good Friday.
That same juror argued against same-sex marriage, civil rights protections for gay and transgender individuals, the contraceptive mandate, and Roe v. Wade.
This ruling against the FDA isn't based on science or safety; It's right-wing activism. Because of rulings like this, and rulings like Kate Cox's, Americans are losing trust and respect in our legal system.
A contribution from you today of any amount can help Democrats regain the majority in Congress, get religion out of politics, advocate for judicial reform, and codify Roe into federal law.
Thank you.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Nikki Haley
subject: The thing about underdogs…
body:
Every race I run, I run to win – even when the odds are stacked against me.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7sg01seokmpkt1uf1i3be4c6i9ugq6i57ln6s8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs)
---

Friend,

I've been the underdog in every race I've run.
---
| | | I was an outsider when I ran for South Carolina's state legislature against a 30-year incumbent. A week before the primary, I was polling at 15 percent
---
| | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zituuu9mav23814cqo5eubc58vsipmi9g1roiarg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs)
---
When I ran for governor, I was the least funded, and the least known GOP candidate in the race. _A few months before Election Day, I was polling in fourth place. _

I've been the underdog each time -- and I've never lost an election.

**[Here's the thing about underdogs-- people underestimate us, we put 1,000% into everything, we take nothing for granted, and we appreciate every single gain we make.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z10vid2l99jokdk1b9pj0n2n3vgrokahtdlidtr0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "Here's the thing about underdogs — people underestimate us, we put 1,000% into everything, we take nothing for granted, and we appreciate every single gain we make.")**

---
| | [DONATE](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2pdndgq65tqelg24g4g79raskpgp2ruahmeqsa8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs)
---

**[Right now, we're making significant gains. Whether it's the latest WSJ poll showing me defeat Biden by 17 points in a head-to-head match-up, supporters overflowing at every venue, or the surge of voters rushing to join our team.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8l2v06sas9rlg85jaifej91k37lpponf4bsj2qg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "Right now, we’re making significant gains. Whether it’s the latest WSJ poll showing me defeat Biden by 17 points in a head-to-head match-up, supporters overflowing at every venue, or the surge of voters rushing to join our team. ")**

Every race I run, I run to win - even when the odds are stacked against me. You know why? Because I will always fight for what's right. I will always rise to the challenge and deliver results for the people.

We have a country to save, and I have the plans to right this ship. **[That's why I'm running for president, and I need your help.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9rs1vk76cgtbq60h28d3s9jiojsdor58sd4ctr0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "That’s why I’m running for president, and I need your help.")**

I've been the underdog in this race since day one. But I've been putting in the work every moment of every day to reach every voter, shake every hand, answer every question, and earn every vote.

Every town hall we host, every ad we air, and every voter we reach gets us one step closer to victory.

But funding these efforts takes a team of grassroots supporters. **[Can I count on you to pitch in a generous donation to help fund my campaign capitalize on our momentum, and WIN the battle for our country.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh6c2jp64ts131p7409v111gou087qe054kqp5bg_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "Can I count on you to pitch in a generous donation to help fund my campaigncapitalize on our momentum, and WIN the battle for our country.")**

Let's do this!

My very best,

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk14oqvip3e0ai6be83fu75vbk8hhdvg7ouljh50_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb32mq22ugc270c52qajh0vfffrfbh3hp6gug3j0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clh69pb7c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**
